title.zh: v2.0.2 真混响与真延迟上线、逐曲风母带效果默认值（dub 长延迟 / ambient 长混响 / metal 饱和）、力度终于改变音色
title.en: v2.0.2 Real reverb and delay, per-genre master FX defaults (dub's long delay, ambient's long reverb, metal's saturation), and velocity that finally changes timbre

highlights.zh: **每个曲风终于有自己的母带效果默认值**（登记项 N-14）。此前全库共用一套机架、四个效果**全部默认关闭**，159 个曲风零声明——「混音按曲风特色」到效果这一层就断了。现在 6 个分类 profile + **55 条逐曲风编排**，三个点名案例：**dub** 用四分音符长延迟、反馈 0.68、反馈环低通 2 kHz（重复逐次变暗）加 ping-pong；**ambient** 用 **9 秒**混响、预延迟 70 ms、返回 0.50；**金属**（death/thrash/heavy/black/metalcore）**饱和开启**（drive 4.5–6）配极小房间。切换曲风即载入该曲风默认（与换 patch 同义）。
highlights.en: **Every genre finally has its own master FX defaults** (registered as N-14). One shared rack with all four effects **off by default** and zero declarations across 159 genres meant "the mix reflects the genre" stopped at the effects layer. There are now six category profiles plus **55 per-genre arrangements**: **dub** gets a quarter-note delay at 0.68 feedback with a 2 kHz low-pass in the loop so repeats darken as they travel, plus ping-pong; **ambient** gets a **9-second** reverb with 70 ms pre-delay and 0.50 return; the **metal** genres get **saturation on** (drive 4.5–6) with a tiny room. Changing genre loads that genre's defaults, exactly like changing a patch.

highlights.zh: **混响和延迟本身也换掉了**。旧混响是一个固定 1.5 秒的**白噪声**脉冲响应：没有频率相关衰减，尾巴一直是亮的、像加了噪声而不是空间；也没有预延迟和早期反射，返回量硬编码。旧延迟固定 250 ms、反馈环里**没有滤波**（每次重复都全带宽、越来越刺耳）、单声道。现在：混响有预延迟 + 5 个早期反射 + **分频段衰减**（高频先衰减，这才是「尾巴随时间变暗」）、可控立体声宽度、确定性种子；延迟可设音乐分割、**反馈环内置低通**、可选 ping-pong。实测 RT60 精度 ~0.2%（0.6 s→0.599、10 s→9.988）。
highlights.en: **The reverb and delay themselves were replaced.** The old reverb was a fixed 1.5 s **white-noise** impulse: no frequency-dependent decay, so the tail stayed bright and read as added noise rather than space, plus no pre-delay, no early reflections and a hard-coded return. The old delay was a fixed 250 ms with **no filter in the feedback loop** (every repeat full-bandwidth, progressively harsher) and mono. Now: pre-delay, five early reflections, **per-band decay** (highs fade first — that is what makes a tail darken), controllable stereo width and a deterministic seed; the delay takes musical divisions, has a **low-pass inside the loop**, and offers ping-pong. Measured RT60 is accurate to ~0.2% (0.6 s→0.599, 10 s→9.988).

highlights.zh: **导出终于和试听是同一条链路**（关闭 N-16）。此前离线导出器**根本没有送出总线、也没有主 FX 机架**：159 个曲风精心编排的混响/延迟送出在成品里完全不存在，用户拧的 FLT/DRIVE/CHORUS/LO-FI 也不在成品里；而且导出用 0.85 推子、实时用 0.8，还有一个无关的 ~0.5 dB 偏差。现在实时与离线共用**同一个** `buildMasterGraph`，链路与逐曲风效果都由同一函数应用。
highlights.en: **Export and audition are finally the same chain** (closing N-16). The offline renderer had **no send buses and no master FX rack at all**: the reverb/delay sends curated for all 159 genres simply were not in the file, and neither was anything dialled into FLT/DRIVE/CHORUS/LO-FI. It also ran a 0.85 fader against playback's 0.8 — an unrelated ~0.5 dB offset. Both now share one `buildMasterGraph`, and the per-genre effects are applied by one shared function.

highlights.zh: **力度终于改变音色，不再只是音量**。此前力度只映射到音量且是线性（力度 64 = −6 dB）。现在有 `v²` 的感知曲线，以及 4 个可选的逐预设力度响应：低通截止、滤波包络深度、起音、衰减。**21 个拟真类预设**（钢琴、Rhodes、立式贝斯、萨克斯、小号、长笛、弦乐、颤音琴、马林巴、钟琴、西塔琴、手风琴、口琴、管风琴、吉他等）已标注，重音更亮更短、弱音更暗更绵。**满力度输出逐字节不变**（对 51 预设 × 3 音高 × 4 时值比较全部调度参数：612/612 一致）。
highlights.en: **Velocity finally changes timbre, not just level.** It previously mapped to amplitude alone and linearly (velocity 64 = −6 dB). There is now a perceptual `v²` curve plus four optional per-preset velocity responses: low-pass cutoff, filter-envelope depth, attack and decay. **21 emulative presets** are annotated (piano, Rhodes, upright bass, sax, trumpet, flute, strings, vibraphone, marimba, bells, sitar, accordion, harmonica, organ, guitars), so accents are brighter and shorter while soft notes are darker and rounder. **Full-velocity output is byte-identical** (verified across 51 presets × 3 pitches × 4 durations, comparing every scheduled parameter: 612/612).

highlights.zh: **打击乐轨从「两种声音」变成 16 个模型**。此前 percussion 轨只能是 808 牛铃或拍手——而拉丁/世界、爵士、Afrobeat 这些曲风**就是**由康加、天巴鼓、沙锤、Clave、Agogo 构成的。现在按轨道声明的乐器名分派：复合 `rim_shaker`（全部 159 个曲风实际用的名字）、膜类（康加/邦戈/天巴/通鼓）、金属类（Agogo/三角铁）、木质类（Clave/边击/木鱼）、沙锤类（沙锤/Cabasa/Guiro/铃鼓），未知名字保持原有回退。鼓也获得力度→音色（亮度/衰减/瞬态），满力度逐参数与旧实现 0 差异。
highlights.en: **The percussion track goes from two sounds to 16 models.** It could only be an 808 cowbell or a handclap — while Latin/World, Jazz and Afrobeat are *built on* congas, timbales, shakers, claves and agogo. Dispatch is now by the track's declared instrument: a composite `rim_shaker` (the name every one of the 159 genres actually uses), membranes (conga/bongo/timbale/tom), metals (agogo/triangle), woods (clave/rimshot/woodblock), shakers (shaker/cabasa/guiro/tambourine), with the original fallback preserved for unknown names. Drums also gained velocity→timbre (brightness, decay, transient), with full velocity unchanged parameter-for-parameter.

highlights.zh: **工作台：FX 机架不再「有壳无芯」**。此前引擎接受 7 个参数，UI 只暴露 4 个开关，于是截止频率永远停在 16 kHz、驱动/混合/位深永远停在默认值。现在抽屉里接出了**对数**截止频率滑条、滤波类型、饱和驱动、合唱混合、比特深度（Q 与合唱速率在高级区），并让 FX 改动**进入撤销栈**——此前改 FX 再按 Ctrl+Z 只回退音符、不回退效果，是个半吊子撤销。这个缺陷是**先写会红的测试**证明的：修改前 7 个参数**0/7** 有写入点。
highlights.en: **Studio: the FX rack is no longer a shell with no core.** The engine accepted seven parameters while the UI exposed four on/off toggles, so cutoff sat at 16 kHz and drive/mix/bit-depth at their defaults forever. The drawer now exposes a **logarithmic** cutoff slider, filter type, saturation drive, chorus mix and bit depth (with Q and chorus rate in an advanced row), and FX edits **join the undo stack** — previously undo rolled back the notes while leaving the effect in place, a half-undo. The defect was proven by a test written to fail first: **0/7** parameters had a write point before the change.

highlights.zh: **GS-1 合成器整合的第一步落地**：vendor 管线与契约门禁。上游 GS-1（MIT、ABI 8）被钉死到 `v2.1.4 @ 2b5b3550`，含两个 wasm（SIMD 217 KB / scalar 203 KB）与许可证；`scripts/sync-gs1.mjs` 是**单向**的（结构上不可能写回上游），`scripts/check-gs1.mjs` 有 **22 项**断言（哈希、ABI、从模块读出的上限、参数表无重复、渲染非静音、零分配违规）。同时给包体门禁**补上 wasm 行**——此前它只看 `.js`，几百 KB 的 wasm 对它完全不可见（实测 147.2 KB）。真正的引擎接入仍待多轨 CPU 实测后再决定范围。
highlights.en: **First step of the GS-1 synth integration lands:** the vendor pipeline and its contract gate. Upstream GS-1 (MIT, ABI 8) is pinned to `v2.1.4 @ 2b5b3550`, including both wasm builds (SIMD 217 KB / scalar 203 KB) and the licence. `scripts/sync-gs1.mjs` is one-directional by construction, and `scripts/check-gs1.mjs` runs **22 assertions** (hashes, ABI, limits read out of the module, no duplicate parameter ids, non-silent render, zero allocation violations). The bundle-budget gate also gained a wasm line — it previously only looked at `.js`, so a few hundred KB of wasm was completely invisible to it (measured: 147.2 KB). Wiring the engine in still waits on a multi-track CPU measurement.

highlights.zh: **全库重新配平**（所有改变电平的改动都必须走这一步）：配平后 p90−p10 **0.59 LU**、全距 3.22 LU、clamp 命中 **0/159**；样本峰值超 0 dBFS **0/159**、最差真峰值 −1.000 dBTP（天花板 −1.0，即限幅器正在工作）。trim 上限由 +6 放宽到 +9，因为新的逐曲风效果把极值拉宽了（`doom-metal` 需要 +6.7 dB），而**被 clamp 的 trim 会静默破坏那个曲风的响度承诺**。
highlights.en: **The library was re-matched** (mandatory for any level-changing work): post-trim spread **0.59 LU** p90−p10, 3.22 LU full range, **0/159** clamp hits; **0/159** genres above 0 dBFS sample peak and a worst true peak of −1.000 dBTP (against a −1.0 ceiling, i.e. the limiter working). The trim ceiling was widened from +6 to +9 because the new per-genre effects widened the extremes (`doom-metal` needs +6.7 dB), and a clamped trim silently breaks the loudness promise for that genre.

title.zh: v2.0.1 和弦按曲风的奏法与乐器：金属闷音不再长鸣、雷鬼不再像垫子、失真节奏吉他上线
title.en: v2.0.1 Chords now use each genre's articulation and instrument: metal mutes stop ringing, reggae stops sounding like a pad, and a high-gain rhythm guitar arrives

highlights.zh: **159 个曲风此前共用一套和弦奏法**：所有音一律「一步的 1.5 倍」长、起始错开固定 3 ms。于是雷鬼的 skank 像垫子一样长鸣、funk 的短促和弦糊成一片、金属的闷音却在延音——音高对了，奏法还是错的。现在有 6 种奏法，按「和弦是在承担节奏还是和声」判定：**stab**（0.30 倍长，1 ms）给 house/techno 短促和弦、funk、雷鬼 skank、蒙图诺与金属闷音；**comp**（0.55 倍、8 ms）给爵士伴奏；**strum**（0.80 倍、22 ms，约一次真实下扫的时长）给吉他；**block**（1.0 倍）是原来的行为；**roll**（1.3 倍、90 ms）给琶音滚奏；**sustain**（**3.0 倍**）给垫子、弦乐、ambient/shoegaze 音墙与黑金属颤音拨弦。
highlights.en: **All 159 genres shared one chord articulation.** Every note was `stepDur · gate · 1.5` long with a flat 3 ms onset stagger — so a reggae skank rang like a pad, funk stabs smeared, and metal's palm mutes sustained. The notes were right; the playing was wrong. There are now six articulations chosen by asking whether the chord carries the *rhythm* or the *harmony*: **stab** (0.30x length, 1 ms) for house/techno stabs, funk, the reggae skank, montuno and palm-muted metal; **comp** (0.55x, 8 ms) for jazz; **strum** (0.80x, 22 ms — roughly a real downstroke) for guitar; **block** (1.0x) as the previous behaviour; **roll** (1.3x, 90 ms) for arpeggiated ripples; and **sustain** (**3.0x**) for pads, strings, ambient/shoegaze walls and tremolo-picked black metal.

highlights.zh: **乐器：数据早就写明每把琴的音色，轨道却一律用同一把**。N-12 的策展为每个金属曲风写了具体音箱——`death-metal` 是「HM-2 Buzzsaw Guitar」、`metalcore` 是「High-Gain 5150 Guitar」、`thrash-metal` 是「Scooped-Mid High-Gain Guitar」——但它们的和弦轨**全部**指向通用的主音吉他预设。新增 **`distortedGuitar` 高增益节奏吉他**：截止 1500 Hz（远低于主音的 2700，power chord 活在低中频，这是它不刺耳的原因）、Q 6.5（远高于 3.5，那个中频鼻音让它切得出来）、双锯齿厚墙、快起音短释放。**定点改 9 个高增益曲风**（hard-rock / punk-rock / heavy-metal / thrash / death / black / doom-metal / metalcore / grunge）；非高增益吉他曲风与所有主音轨**不动**。
highlights.en: **Instruments: the data already described each amplifier, but every track used the same generic guitar.** The N-12 curation names a specific amp per metal genre — "HM-2 Buzzsaw Guitar" for death metal, "High-Gain 5150 Guitar" for metalcore, "Scooped-Mid High-Gain Guitar" for thrash — yet all of their chords tracks pointed at the generic lead-guitar preset. A new **`distortedGuitar` high-gain rhythm voice** lands: 1500 Hz cutoff (far below the lead's 2700 — a power chord lives in the low-mids, which is why it does not fizz), Q 6.5 (vs 3.5 — that midrange honk is what makes it cut), a thick two-saw stack, fast attack and short release. **Nine high-gain genres** are switched over; non-high-gain guitar genres and every lead track are left alone.

highlights.zh: **既有门禁把「器材意图」和「轨道」绑在了一起**：`distorted_guitar` 的允许短语直接取自策展文案里已有的词（high-gain / buzzsaw / fuzz / overdriven guitar / tremolo-picked / down-tuned），所以「轨道乐器必须被该曲风的配器清单点名」这条老门禁现在会自动要求两者一致。新增乐器的钉死清单也如期拦下并要求显式更新——这正是它们存在的意义。
highlights.en: **Existing gates now tie amplifier intent to the track.** The new instrument's allowed phrases are taken straight from the curation text (high-gain, buzzsaw, fuzz, overdriven guitar, tremolo-picked, down-tuned), so the long-standing rule that a track's instrument must be *named* by its genre's instrumentation list now enforces the two agree. The pinned instrument survey also caught the new voice and demanded a deliberate update — which is exactly why it exists.

highlights.zh: **重新配平**：奏法显著改变能量分布（stab 只有原来的 30% 长度、sustain 是 300%），因此按流程重测 159 曲风并回填 trim。配平后 p90−p10 **0.69 LU**（上限 1.5）、全距 2.77 LU、clamp 0/159；样本峰值超 0 dBFS 仍为 **0/159**，最差真峰值 −0.983 dBTP。
highlights.en: **Re-matched.** Articulation changes the energy distribution materially (a stab is 30% of the old length, a sustain 300%), so all 159 genres were re-measured and the trims refitted: post-trim spread **0.69 LU** p90−p10 (limit 1.5), 2.77 LU full range, 0/159 clamp hits — and clipping remains **0/159** with a worst true peak of −0.983 dBTP.

highlights.zh: **测试覆盖三层且断言的是音乐主张**：奏法按音长正确排序（stab < comp < strum < block < sustain）；funk/雷鬼/salsa/techno/金属的 gateScale ≤ 0.6，ambient/trance/shoegaze/doom/black 的 ≥ 1.5；**端到端**渲染出的音长与起始展开和解析器一致（用同乐器对照隔离奏法，避免被预设自身的释放时间混淆）；失真吉他**可测地更重**（更暗、更冲、更厚、更紧）而不只是改了标签。
highlights.en: **Three layers of tests, asserting musical claims.** Articulations order correctly by length (stab < comp < strum < block < sustain); funk/reggae/salsa/techno/metal sit at gateScale ≤ 0.6 while ambient/trance/shoegaze/doom/black sit at ≥ 1.5; the **rendered** note length and onset spread match the resolver (compared on a matched instrument so the preset's own release cannot confound it); and the distorted guitar is **measurably** heavier — darker, more aggressive, thicker, tighter — not merely relabelled.

highlights.zh: 顺带修掉一个自己写的静默失效：真峰值汇总块用 `arrangedTruePeakDb` 过滤，但序列化报告里只写了 `trimmedTruePeakDb`，于是整块被悄悄跳过。已修，并把两个字段都写进报告。
highlights.en: Also fixed a silent self-inflicted failure: the true-peak summary filtered on `arrangedTruePeakDb` while the serialized report only wrote `trimmedTruePeakDb`, so the whole block was quietly skipped. Both fields are now reported.

title.zh: v2.0.0 工作台重构启动：布局偏好持久化（刷新不再丢失侧栏/力度条/高级抽屉状态）
title.en: v2.0.0 Studio refactor begins: layout preferences persist (no more re-collapsing the sidebar after every refresh)

highlights.zh: **工作台重构规划正式启动，版本序列进入 2.0**：原计划的 v1.17.0–v1.17.13 改为 **v2.0.0–v2.0.12**，首个里程碑为布局偏好持久化。这一版是 2.0 序列的起点，后续每个里程碑都是可独立发布的小版本。
highlights.en: **The studio refactor officially starts and versioning moves to 2.0.** The plan's v1.17.0–v1.17.13 milestones become **v2.0.0–v2.0.12**, beginning with layout-preference persistence. Each milestone ships as its own small release.

highlights.zh: **布局不再每次刷新都归零**：侧栏折叠、工作台最大化、力度泳道、分析仪、高级抽屉这 5 个开关此前全是裸 `useState(false)`，全仓库没有任何持久化——每次刷新、每次从调音台/对比视图回来，都要重新收侧栏、重新开力度条。现在挂载时读一次、变更即写。
highlights.en: **Layout no longer resets on every refresh.** All five toggles — sidebar collapse, editor maximise, velocity lane, analyser, advanced drawer — were plain `useState(false)` with no persistence anywhere in the repo, so every refresh (and every trip to the console or compare view) meant re-collapsing the sidebar and re-opening the velocity lane. They are now read once on mount and written on change.

highlights.zh: **存储损坏绝不会弄坏工作台**：读取失败（无 storage／隐私模式抛错／配额）一律回落默认且**绝不抛错**；一个字段类型不对时**逐字段修复**，而不是把其余四个好设置一起丢掉；遇到未知的 `version` 则整体回落——形状不认识就不猜。键为 `groove_layout_prefs_v1` 且载荷内含 `version`，按计划「一旦写到用户机器上就永不删除」的纪律，未来改形状要加 v2 并保留 v1 作迁移源。
highlights.en: **Corrupt storage can never break the studio.** Any read failure (no storage, a privacy mode that throws, quota) falls back to defaults and **never throws**; a single wrong-typed field is repaired **in place** rather than discarding the other four good settings; an unknown `version` falls back wholesale, because guessing at an unrecognised shape is worse than resetting. The key is `groove_layout_prefs_v1` with the version also inside the payload, so a future shape change must add v2 and keep v1 as a migration source.

highlights.zh: **演奏状态明确不持久化**：「只听鼓组」「键盘模式」「录音待命」被有意排除在偏好之外，并在代码里写明理由——它们描述的是演奏中的实时状态，静默恢复会在下次打开时重新武装录音或重进只听鼓组。测试从两个方向守护：类型层拒绝，以及绕开类型（模拟从解析出的 JSON 展开）时运行时过滤器仍拦下。
highlights.en: **Performance state is deliberately not persisted.** Drums-only, keyboard mode and record-armed are excluded on purpose, with the reasoning in the code: they describe live performance state, and silently restoring them would re-arm the recorder or re-enter drums-only on the next visit. Tests guard this from both directions — the type system rejects them, and the runtime filter still catches them when the types are bypassed.

highlights.zh: **验证强度如实说明**：本版交付了模块级往返测试（走真实 `localStorage`）与源码级接线守护（断言 5 个开关全部落盘、会话态不落盘），共 35 条。**浏览器级「刷新后原样恢复」的端到端断言按计划归属后续里程碑的 7 端 E2E 矩阵**，因此这里不把「单元测试通过」表述为「浏览器已验收」。
highlights.en: **Verification strength, stated honestly.** This release ships module-level round-trip tests through the real `localStorage` plus a source-level wiring guard asserting all five toggles are persisted and the session-only flags are not — 35 cases. The **browser-level "still collapsed after a refresh" end-to-end assertion belongs to a later milestone's seven-target E2E matrix**, so unit tests passing is not presented here as browser acceptance.

title.zh: v1.16.21 母带换上真正的真峰值前瞻限幅器（削波 121→0 个曲风），和弦开始按曲风选声部
title.en: v1.16.21 A real true-peak lookahead limiter (clipping 121 genres → 0), and chords voiced for the genre

highlights.zh: **母带限幅器原来不是限幅器（已登记的 N-15）**：它是个 `DynamicsCompressorNode`，20:1、**3 ms 起攻**且无前瞻——底鼓/军鼓的瞬态在增益衰减介入前就已经过去了，超量还按 1/20 放行。实测后果：**159 个曲风里有 121 个渲染出的样本峰值超过 0 dBFS**，被 16-bit 编码器硬削平。现在换成真正的**前瞻式真峰值砖墙限幅器**：3 ms 前瞻（增益在瞬态到达输出前就已压低）、4× 过采样真峰值检测（能看见**采样间过冲**，而不只是采样点）、−1.0 dBTP 硬天花板、立体声联动、分级释放。
highlights.en: **The master "limiter" was not a limiter (registered as N-15).** It was a `DynamicsCompressorNode` at 20:1 with a **3 ms attack** and no lookahead — kick and snare transients had already passed before the detector closed, and 1/20 of the excess sailed through. Measured result: **121 of 159 genres rendered sample peaks above 0 dBFS**, hard-clipped by the 16-bit encoder. It is now a real **lookahead true-peak brickwall**: 3 ms of lookahead (gain is down before the transient reaches the output), 4x-oversampled true-peak detection (so **inter-sample** overshoots are caught, not just sample points), a −1.0 dBTP hard ceiling, stereo-linked gain, and programme-dependent release.

highlights.zh: **实测：削波从 121/159 降到 0/159，最差真峰值 −0.996 dBTP**（天花板 −1.0）。全库重新实测并回填 159 条响度 trim：配平后 p90−p10 0.80 LU、全距 2.53 LU、clamp 命中 0/159。库整体电平下降约 0.7 dB——真正的前瞻天花板比原来那个压缩器严格，这是预期且正确的方向。
highlights.en: **Measured: clipping falls from 121/159 to 0/159, worst true peak −0.996 dBTP** against a −1.0 ceiling. All 159 loudness trims were re-measured and refitted: post-trim spread 0.80 LU p90−p10, 2.53 LU full range, 0/159 clamp hits. The library sits about 0.7 dB lower overall — a genuine lookahead ceiling is stricter than the compressor it replaced, which is the intended direction.

highlights.zh: **新增真峰值表（V-03）并把它接成门禁**：此前无真峰值度量，所以「采样间过冲」这类问题**看不见**。现在 `loudness` 助手提供 4× 过采样真峰值，门禁新增两条会失败的断言——0 个曲风超 0 dBFS 样本峰值、无曲风超出 −1 dBTP（容差 0.02 dB）。只有真峰值能看见限幅器存在的意义，只看样本峰值恰好漏掉它。
highlights.en: **A true-peak meter (V-03), wired in as a gate.** There was no true-peak measurement, so inter-sample overshoot was **invisible**. The loudness helper now reports 4x-oversampled true peak, and the gate gained two assertions that can fail: zero genres above 0 dBFS sample peak, and none beyond −1 dBTP (0.02 dB tolerance). Only a true-peak meter can see the failure the limiter exists to prevent.

highlights.zh: **和弦按曲风选声部形态（用户反馈）**：此前一律是自然音阶 1-3-5，对大多数曲风都不对。现在有 9 种形态：**power**（根音+纯五+八度，**无三度**——摇滚/金属的失真下三度会糊成一团）、**shell**/**extended**（爵士只留 3 度与 7 度、再叠 9 度）、**quartal**（叠四度，modal/free jazz）、**seventh**（布鲁斯/灵魂/迪斯科/boom-bap）、**sus**/**open**（环境与 shoegaze 的无三度音墙）、**add9**（city pop / j-pop / trance）。新增 `src/data/genreVoicing.ts`：6 个分类默认 + 约 80 条逐曲风 override。
highlights.en: **Chords are now voiced for the genre (user feedback).** A generic diatonic 1-3-5 was wrong for most of the library. There are now nine voices: **power** (root + fifth + octave, **no third** — under distortion the third is what turns a chord to mush), **shell**/**extended** (jazz keeps the 3rd and 7th, adding the 9th), **quartal** (stacked fourths for modal/free jazz), **seventh** (blues, soul, disco, boom-bap), **sus**/**open** (the thirdless ambient/shoegaze wall), **add9** (city pop, J-pop, trance). New `src/data/genreVoicing.ts`: six category defaults plus ~80 per-genre overrides.

highlights.zh: **但曲风数据本身给不出这个信息**：`common_chords` 在 159 个曲风里**只有 2 个互不相同的字符串**，连 Jazz/Blues 与 Rock/Metal 都完全一样。所以爵士的和声变化只能来自上面那张按曲风键控的表；`common_chords` 的退化已登记为后续数据项（与 instrumentation 在 N-12 之前的状态同类）。
highlights.en: **The genre data itself cannot supply this.** `common_chords` holds only **two distinct strings across all 159 genres**, identical even for Jazz/Blues and Rock/Metal. Jazz harmony therefore has to come from the genre-keyed table above; the degeneracy of `common_chords` is registered as a follow-up data item (the same state `instrumentation` was in before N-12).

highlights.zh: **实时与导出必须给出同一组音**：声部形态在实时引擎与离线导出器各自解析（一个实时、一个离线），所以除了单元测试，另加**端到端断言**——直接检查渲染出来的音：`death-metal` → 根音+五度+八度、`bebop` → C-Eb-Bb-D、`ambient` 无三度，且两个引擎对 5 个曲风给出完全相同的音。
highlights.en: **Playback and export must produce the same notes.** The two engines resolve the voicing independently (one realtime, one offline), so beyond unit tests there are **end-to-end assertions** on the rendered pitches: `death-metal` gives root+fifth+octave, `bebop` gives C-Eb-Bb-D, `ambient` has no third, and both engines agree exactly on five genres.

title.zh: v1.16.20 让每个曲风真的弹出和声、修掉一批能听见的音质缺陷，并让更新记录不再看不到最新版
title.en: v1.16.20 Real harmony for every genre, a batch of audible audio defects fixed, and release notes that can no longer miss the newest entry

highlights.zh: **和弦轨第一次真的有和声**：此前 `chords` 轨只触发一个音，159 个曲风声明的 `common_chords` 走向从未到达引擎——所谓「垫子」其实是穿着 pad 音色的单音旋律。现在按曲风自己的调式做自然音阶和声（定位根音音级，再叠 1-3-5），实时与离线导出调用同一模块，**零曲风文件改动**。
highlights.en: **The chords track finally has harmony.** It triggered a single note, so the `common_chords` progression every genre declares never reached the engine — the "pad" was a single-note melody wearing a pad preset. It now builds a diatonic voicing in the genre's own scale, from one module shared by playback and export, with **zero genre-file edits**.

highlights.zh: **修掉每个长音都在响的咔哒声**：衰减比音符长时，包络会从衰减曲线硬跳到延持电平——`bass808` 在 1/16 音符上约 **−4.6 dB 阶跃**，等于一个宽带脉冲。808 贝斯、钢琴、Rhodes、颤音琴、钟琴、西塔琴、立式贝斯都受影响。改为从解析求出的真实值开始释放。
highlights.en: **Fixed a click that fired on every sustained note.** When the decay outlasted the note, the envelope hard-stepped to the sustain level — about **−4.6 dB** on `bass808`, i.e. a broadband impulse. The 808 bass, piano, Rhodes, vibraphone, bells, sitar and upright bass were all affected. The release now starts from the envelope's analytically computed value.

highlights.zh: **母带主滤波此前从未真正旁通**：`DEFAULT_FX_STATE` 说它是关的，但节点按状态值构造，于是**实时母带一直挂着一个 16 kHz 双极点低通**，而离线导出器整条机架都不存在。现在按接线真旁通（BiquadFilter 没有透明类型，改频率只是假旁通），并修掉非 lowpass 类型的旁通值错误。
highlights.en: **The master filter was never actually bypassed.** The node was built from the state values even though `DEFAULT_FX_STATE` says it is off, so **the live master always carried a 16 kHz low-pass** while the exporter has no rack at all. Bypass is now a true re-route (a BiquadFilter has no transparent type), and the wrong bypass value for non-lowpass types is fixed.

highlights.zh: **降比特器其实没在降比特**：量化表只有 2048 点而量化级数可达 65536，`bits ≥ 11` 的设置完全失效——**出厂默认就是 12**。表长改为按级数自适应，并补 4× 过采样消除折叠失真；注释明确记录「采样率抽取未实现」及原因（WaveShaper 无记忆）。
highlights.en: **The bitcrusher did not actually crush.** Its 2048-point table could not resolve a quantizer reaching 65536 levels, so any `bits ≥ 11` was meaningless — **the default was 12**. The table is now sized from the level count, 4x oversampling stops harmonic fold-back, and the comment states plainly that sample-rate decimation is not implemented and why.

highlights.zh: **鼓噪声可复现且每击不同**：噪声床、混响 IR 与离线噪声此前全部来自 `Math.random()`，两次渲染都不一致、导出也无法保证与试听相同；而每个鼓点又从 buffer 的 0 偏移读起，16 分踩镲是**逐字节相同**的一段。现在统一用种子生成器，并给每击一个由「轨/步/连击」确定性推出的读取偏移，实时与离线共用同一公式。
highlights.en: **Drum noise is reproducible and varies per hit.** The noise bed, reverb impulse and offline noise all came from `Math.random()`, so renders disagreed and an export could not match the audition; separately every hit read from offset 0, making a 16th-note hat pattern byte-identical repetition. Both now use one seeded generator, with a per-hit offset derived deterministically from track/step/ratchet.

highlights.zh: **「更新后看不到最新更新记录」的根因修复**：① `/changelog.json` 允许缓存 1 小时；② Service Worker 走 stale-while-revalidate 先返回旧副本、回填后不重渲染；③ **弹窗把「归档」的优先级放在刚用 `no-store` 校验过的 `latest` 之上**，旧归档直接顶掉最新一条——这解释了为何版本号正确、只有记录是旧的。现在归档 URL 按版本作键、渲染改为「归档 ∪ latest」按版本降序、两个文件在 SW 中改为 Network First（对已部署的旧前端同样生效）。
highlights.en: **Root cause of "I updated but cannot see the newest release note".** (1) `/changelog.json` cached for an hour; (2) the service worker served it stale-while-revalidate, returning the old copy and never re-rendering after the refresh; (3) **the modal ranked the archive above the `latest` entry just revalidated with `no-store`**, so a stale archive displaced the newest entry — which is why the version was right and only the notes were old. The archive URL is now version-keyed, rendering is a version-descending union, and both files are network-first in the worker.

highlights.zh: **其余可听/可测修复**：踢鼓逐 voice 饱和补 4× 过采样并把失真曲线改为缓存（此前每次踩击分配 4096 个 float）；调音台声相与两条送出改为斜坡写入，拖推子不再有阶梯噪声；`VoiceRegistry` 增加复音上限与**无咔哒抢音**（优先抢最接近自然结束的 voice）。
highlights.en: **Other audible/measurable fixes.** The per-voice kick saturation gained 4x oversampling and a cached distortion curve (it allocated 4096 floats per hit). Console pan and both sends now ramp instead of stepping, removing zipper noise. `VoiceRegistry` gained a polyphony ceiling with **click-free stealing**, preferring the voice closest to finishing.

highlights.zh: **全库响度重新配平且更整齐**：加入和声抬高和弦轨峰值，因而**更狠地触发母带限幅器**把整个混音压低（全量实测 arranged 平均 −1.42 dB，最差 techstep −4.98）——这是 N-15 的又一次实证。按流程重测 159 曲风并回填 trim：配平后 p90−p10 由 0.51 LU 收到 **0.32 LU**，全距 1.11 LU，clamp 0/159。
highlights.en: **The library was re-matched — and is now tighter.** Harmony raises the chord peak, which **drives the master limiter harder and pumps the whole mix down** (−1.42 dB average arranged, worst `techstep` −4.98) — more evidence for N-15. All 159 genres were re-measured and trims refitted: post-trim p90−p10 improved from 0.51 LU to **0.32 LU**, range 1.11 LU, 0/159 clamp hits.

title.zh: v1.16.19 每个曲风一套按曲风编排的混音，并把 159 个曲风的总响度配平
title.en: v1.16.19 A genre-arranged mix for every genre, and loudness matched across all 159

highlights.zh: 每个曲风一套自己的混音（用户需求）：此前 159 个曲风共用同一套默认值——底鼓一律 0.90、主音一律偏右 0.10、混响与延迟送出**全部为 0**（两条送出总线其实是死的）。现在每个曲风按自己的性格编排：159 个曲风里 (音量, 声相) 组合有 157 种互不相同。爵士把立式贝斯推到 0.96~0.98 而鼓组后撤到 0.60~0.68；萨尔萨的打击乐推满并铺到左侧；雷鬼低音推到 1.00；金属把和弦与主音分别拉硬左硬右（双轨吉他）；ambient 的鼓组几乎退场而垫子挑大梁；trap 的底鼓与低音推到 0.98/0.99、踩镲铺宽
highlights.en: A mix of its own for every genre: all 159 genres used to share one set of defaults — kick always 0.90, lead always panned +0.10, and the reverb/delay sends all zero (the two send buses were effectively dead). Each genre is now arranged to its own character, with 157 distinct (volume, pan) combinations across the 159. Jazz pushes the upright bass to 0.96–0.98 and pulls the kit back to 0.60–0.68; salsa pushes percussion to full and spreads it left; reggae takes the bass to 1.00; metal splits chords and lead hard left and right as double-tracked guitars; ambient all but removes the kit and lets the pads carry it; trap runs kick and bass at 0.98/0.99 with wide hats

highlights.zh: 总响度配平（用户需求）：切换曲风时总响度不再跳变。做法是逐个曲风离线渲染其默认 pattern，按 ITU-R BS.1770-4 门控积分响度（LUFS，含 400ms/75% 分块、−70 LUFS 绝对门与 −10 LU 相对门）实测，以全库中位数为目标生成每个曲风的母带微调。配平前 p90−p10 为 4.69 LU、全距 9.96 LU；配平后为 **0.51 LU / 1.25 LU**，且没有任何一个曲风撞到 ±clamp 边界
highlights.en: Loudness matching: the total level no longer jumps when you switch genres. Each genre's default pattern is rendered offline and measured as ITU-R BS.1770-4 gated integrated loudness (LUFS — 400 ms blocks at 75% overlap, −70 LUFS absolute gate, −10 LU relative gate); a per-genre master trim is derived against the library median. Before matching the p90−p10 spread was 4.69 LU with a 9.96 LU full range; after, it is **0.51 LU / 1.25 LU**, with no genre hitting the clamp bounds

highlights.zh: 曲风比对也一起配平：单曲风试听各自使用本曲风的微调；同步 A/B 模式按当前**实际在响**的曲风重算（只独奏某一侧时就用那一侧自己的微调）。此前同步模式固定用两首的均值，独奏一侧时最差会偏 4.98 dB——即为了对比而独奏时反而最不准
highlights.en: The compare view is matched too: a single-genre audition uses that genre's own trim, and the synchronised A/B mode recomputes from whichever genres are actually audible — isolating one side uses that side's own trim. It previously pinned the average of the two, which left isolating a side off by up to 4.98 dB — exactly when you isolate to compare

highlights.zh: 微调是一个独立于音量的母带级（在用户推子与听力保护钳制之后、母带限幅器之前），因此推子始终只表示你要的音量，而导出与试听一致：离线 WAV 导出在同一相对位置套用同一个微调。「响度配平」不会被误当成用户调过音量
highlights.en: The trim is a separate master stage from the volume fader (after the user fader and hearing-protection clamp, before the master limiter), so the fader keeps meaning exactly the level you asked for, and bounces match auditions: the offline WAV exporter applies the same trim in the same relative position

highlights.zh: 旧会话的兼容：老用户上次存下的会话快照里那套旧占位混音会按轨迁移到新编排——只迁移「从未被用户动过」的通道（音量、声相、两条送出都还是旧占位值的那些），你在调音台里动过的通道保留你自己的值。否则老用户会一直听到旧的扁平混音，新表根本到不了耳朵里
highlights.en: Existing sessions are migrated per channel: a saved session's old placeholder values move to the new arrangement only on channels the user never touched (volume, pan and both sends still matching the old placeholder); channels you moved in the console keep your values. Without this, a returning user would keep hearing the old flat mix and the new table would never reach their ears

highlights.zh: 修正分享链接的另一半：工具栏分享按钮此前丢掉了声相、混响/延迟送出、门限、连击、概率、轨道长度与摇摆八个字段（编解码器一直支持、工程中心也映射齐全，只有工作台这个入口是内联拼装漏了）。现在两处共用同一映射实现，并有三条端到端测试直接对生成的链接断言——否则按曲风编排好的声相与送出一分享就没了
highlights.en: The other half of the share fix: the studio toolbar's share button was dropping eight per-track fields (pan, reverb/delay sends, gate, ratchet, probability, track length, swing) even though the codec always supported them and the project hub mapped them all. Both entry points now share one mapper, with three end-to-end tests asserting on the generated link — otherwise the genre-arranged pan and sends would vanish the moment you shared a pattern

title.zh: v1.16.18 159 个曲风改用本命音色与真实配器清单：爵士用萨克斯小号、拉丁用铜管长笛、电子保留模拟合成
title.en: v1.16.18 All 159 genres re-voiced with their own idioms and real instrumentation lists: horns for jazz, brass and flute for Latin, analog synths kept for electronic

highlights.zh: 曲风音色策展（核心）：上一版让引擎开始按曲风数据里声明的乐器发声，但数据本身并不「曲风惯用」——爵士家族的 lead 是锯齿合成主音、全库 159 个曲风的 FX 都是同一条合成 riser。这一版把 159 个曲风逐一改成本命音色：主音从 5 种扩到 27 种（锯齿从 92 个曲风降到 28 个），FX 从 1 种扩到 9 种，低音 9→14 种、和弦 6→11 种
highlights.en: Genre timbre curation (core): the previous release made the engine honour the instrument each genre declares, but the data itself was not idiomatic — the jazz family's lead was a saw synth and every one of the 159 genres used the same synth riser for FX. This release re-voices all 159 genres: leads go from 5 kinds to 27 (saw leads drop from 92 genres to 28), FX from 1 to 9, bass 9 to 14, chords 6 to 11

highlights.zh: 具体到你会在意的听感：bebop、hard-bop、cool-jazz、modal-jazz、free-jazz、traditional-jazz 现在的主音是萨克斯、小号与弱音小号，芝加哥蓝调是口琴，拉丁与世界音乐改用铜管组、长笛与手风琴，摇滚金属保持双吉他（本来就对，没有乱动）。电子分支中真有模拟合成传统的那 28 个曲风保留锯齿主音，理由逐个写在 TIMBRE_NOTES.md 里
highlights.en: Concretely: bebop, hard-bop, cool-jazz, modal-jazz, free-jazz and traditional-jazz now lead with saxophone, trumpet and muted trumpet; Chicago blues with harmonica; Latin and world genres move to brass section, flute and accordion; rock and metal keep their twin guitars (already correct, left alone). The 28 electronic genres with a genuine analog-synth tradition keep their saw leads, with the reason recorded genre by genre in TIMBRE_NOTES.md

highlights.zh: 「核心配器」终于名副其实：曲风详情页、曲风比对页与时间线悬浮提示里展示的配器清单，此前 159 个曲风是**同一句占位串**（「合成器、鼓机、贝斯、采样器、FX」——bebop 的核心配器被显示成这个）。现在 159 个曲风各有各的清单，写的是真实器材与音色，例如「M1 Organ Bass Stabs、Analog Synth Lead、Sub Bass、TR-909 Hats & Kicks」
highlights.en: "Core instrumentation" finally means something: the instrumentation list shown on the genre detail page, the compare page and the timeline tooltip was a single placeholder string repeated across all 159 genres ("Synthesizer, Drum Machine, Bass, Sampler, FX" — that is what bebop's core instrumentation said). All 159 genres now carry their own list of real instruments and sounds, e.g. "M1 Organ Bass Stabs, Analog Synth Lead, Sub Bass, TR-909 Hats & Kicks"

highlights.zh: 合成器预设库从 20 件扩到 49 件，新增 30 件带真实合成参数的预设（萨克斯、小号、弱音小号、铜管组、钢琴、风琴、颤音琴、弦乐、拨弦、排箫、西塔琴、手风琴、口琴、马林巴、钟琴、正弦主音、FM 主音、牛铃、咆哮主音，以及黑胶底噪、磁带停转、反向镲、上升噪、下扫、低频下坠、激光等效果音），不是把旧预设改名
highlights.en: The synthesizer preset library grows from 20 to 49 with 30 presets built from real synthesis parameters (sax, trumpet, muted trumpet, brass section, piano, organ, vibraphone, strings, plucked string, pan flute, sitar, accordion, harmonica, marimba, bells, sine lead, FM lead, cowbell, growl lead, plus vinyl crackle, tape stop, reverse cymbal, noise rise, down sweep, sub drop and laser FX) — new voices, not renamed copies

highlights.zh: 新增曲风配器完整性门禁：断言配器清单条目数与互异度、禁止通用占位词、要求每个轨道声明的乐器都被配器清单点名、并要求 FX 与主音不得再次单值化——八条断言逐条反向验证过（故意把数据改回同质化，确认门禁转红）
highlights.en: A new instrumentation integrity gate asserts list length and distinctness, bans generic placeholder words, requires every declared track instrument to be named in that genre's list, and refuses a single-valued FX or lead again — all eight assertions were reverse-validated by deliberately homogenising the data and confirming they go red

highlights.zh: 修复真实缺陷：从工作台分享出去的链接会丢掉声相、混响/延迟送出、门限、连击、概率、轨道长度与摇摆——分享编解码器一直支持这些字段，工程中心的入口也映射齐全，只有工具栏的分享按钮是内联拼装、漏了 8 个字段。现在两个入口共用同一个映射实现，并补了三条端到端测试直接对生成的 URL 断言
highlights.en: Fixed a real defect: links shared from the studio arrived without pan, reverb/delay sends, gate, ratchet, probability, track length or swing — the share codec always supported them and the project hub mapped them all, but the studio toolbar's share button built the payload inline and dropped eight fields. Both entry points now share one mapper, with three end-to-end tests asserting directly on the generated URL

title.zh: v1.16.17 工作台内一键浮出调音台：同一套引擎、同一份 pattern，而不是第二套
title.en: v1.16.17 One-click floating mixing console inside the studio — the same engine and the same pattern, not a second copy

highlights.zh: 工作台内浮出调音台（用户需求）：律动工作台工具栏新增「调音台」按钮（快捷键 C），点击即在当前工程上浮出完整调音台抽屉，8 条通道条、母带推子、立体声峰值表、SEND A/B、M/S/Ø 与走带一应俱全；关闭后回到原来的编辑现场，pattern、撤销栈、FX 一个不丢
highlights.en: Floating console inside the studio: the studio toolbar gains a Mixing Console button (shortcut C) that floats the full desk over the current project — eight channel strips, master fader, stereo peak meters, SEND A/B, M/S/Ø and transport. Closing it returns you to the exact editing state: pattern, undo stack and FX all intact

highlights.zh: 关键实现：把调音台拆成「纯展示的面板」与「持有引擎和状态的路由」。面板不再自己 new 引擎、不再自己建音序状态，而是由宿主注入——浮层复用工作台正在用的那一个引擎与那一份 pattern。浏览器实测（启动前包装 AudioContext 构造计数）：打开浮层前后 AudioContext 构造数恒为 1，浮层里推的推子改的就是工作台里的那条轨道
highlights.en: The crux: the desk is split into a presentational panel and the route that owns the engine and state. The panel no longer constructs an engine or a store of its own — the host injects the studio's live engine and pattern. Verified in a real browser (AudioContext constructor counted from before app boot): the construction count stays at 1 whether the drawer is open or closed, and a fader moved in the drawer edits the very track the studio is playing

highlights.zh: 顺带修掉一个真实可用性缺陷：1440px 下 9 条通道横向溢出约 176px，母带推子与播放/停止原本要横向滚动才能碰到。现在母带条吸附在滚动容器右缘（带投影边缘），无论通道滚到哪里，母带与走带始终在原地
highlights.en: Fixed a real usability defect found while verifying: at 1440px the nine strips overflow by ~176px, so the master fader and transport used to require horizontal scrolling. The master strip is now pinned to the right edge of the scroll container (with a soft edge shadow), so master and transport never move no matter how far you scroll the channels

highlights.zh: 细节对齐：浮层的走带直接复用工作台的播放状态与处理函数（两个播放键不可能各说各话）；浮层打开时启用引擎真实分析器、关闭时释放，而工作台侧边栏的分析仪走母带分析器、不受影响；轨道状态同步补上此前到不了引擎的反相字段；独立 /console 路由退化为 55 行薄包装，行为不变
highlights.en: Details kept honest: the drawer's transport reuses the studio's own playing state and handler, so the two play buttons cannot disagree; real per-track analysers are enabled while the drawer is open and released on close, while the studio sidebar analyser reads the master analyser and is unaffected; track-state sync now forwards the phase-invert field that previously never reached the engine; the standalone /console route collapses to a 55-line wrapper with unchanged behaviour

highlights.zh: 四种关闭路径（Esc、C、关闭按钮、点击遮罩）与关着时完全不渲染（不挡工作台走带与网格）均已覆盖测试；配合反向验证（把面板改回自己 new 引擎、把 commit 改成空转、关掉 Esc/C 分支等），确认对应用例确实转红后再恢复
highlights.en: All four dismissal paths (Esc, C, close button, backdrop click) are covered by tests, as is rendering nothing while closed so the studio transport and grid stay usable. Each new test was reverse-validated: making the panel construct its own engine, no-op the commit, or disable the Esc/C branches turned exactly the intended tests red before being restored

title.zh: v1.16.16 曲风音色真正落地：159 种曲风的 LEAD/FX/低音/和弦按各自乐器发声，并修复底鼓首击无声与导出包版本戳
title.en: v1.16.16 Real per-genre timbres: all 159 genres now voice lead/FX/bass/chords with their declared instruments, plus kick first-trigger silence and stale export version-stamp fixes

highlights.zh: 曲风音色映射（核心）：曲风数据一直为 8 条轨道声明了 instrument（如 flute_lead、rhodes_ep、808_bass、sub_bass），但引擎从前忽略它，无论什么曲风都按轨道角色套同一个固定预设——长笛主导的曲风会响成锯齿合成主音。现在新增音色解析模块，按「精确预设名 → 别名表 → 轨道角色默认 → 全局默认」四级回退链取用，并把每件乐器补齐为独立合成器预设，实时播放与离线 WAV 导出解析同一个预设，导出不再与试听两套音色
highlights.en: Per-genre timbres (core): the genre data has always declared an instrument per track (flute_lead, rhodes_ep, 808_bass, sub_bass, …) but the engine ignored it and played the same fixed per-role preset for every genre — a flute-led genre sounded like a saw lead. A new resolver maps instrument → synth preset through a four-step fallback chain (exact preset key → alias table → track-role default → global default), every declared instrument now has its own synthesizer preset, and the offline WAV renderer resolves the same preset so exports match what you auditioned

highlights.zh: 数据零改动、可验证：音色映射由测试直接扫描 src/data/genres 下 159×8 个 (轨道, 乐器) 组合生成，与类型化导出交叉比对，断言没有任何一个组合落到全局默认值，且各乐器音色彼此可区分——映射表不会随数据漂移而静默失效
highlights.en: Zero data edits, fully verifiable: the mapping is enumerated by tests that scan all 159×8 (track, instrument) pairs straight out of src/data/genres, cross-check them against the typed exports, and assert that no pair falls through to the global default and that timbres are audibly distinct — so the table can never silently go stale as data drifts

highlights.zh: 修复真实缺陷：底鼓设计页的「INITIATE PULSE」首次点击无声。根因是音频上下文只由同页另一个按钮创建，先点播放就等于在静音上下文里调度。改为引擎层按需惰性创建上下文，触发时自愈并重挂分析器
highlights.en: Fixed a real defect: the kick designer's INITIATE PULSE was silent on its first click. The audio context was only ever created by the page's other button, so pressing play first scheduled into a silent context. The engine now lazily creates its context on demand and self-heals on trigger, re-attaching the analyser

highlights.zh: 修复真实缺陷：导出的 .groove 工程包版本戳一直是写死的「1.15.2」，落后两个小版本。同时补上红线 R1b——src 下只允许 src/version.ts 出现版本号字面量；红线总数 19 → 20
highlights.en: Fixed a real defect: exported .groove project packages always carried a hardcoded "1.15.2" version stamp, two minor versions stale. Added red line R1b: no version literal may appear under src/ except in src/version.ts. Red lines 19 → 20

highlights.zh: 全景声谱仪：内置声学参考测试信号发生器搬到分析仪仪器本体上——仪器头部新增电源按钮，启用后旁边的下拉框直接选择 6 种内置信号，下方原有的参考信号区块完整保留，两处共用同一个发生器实例
highlights.en: Master analyzer: the built-in acoustic reference signal generator moved onto the instrument itself — a power button in the instrument header with an adjacent dropdown for the six built-in signals, while the original reference-signal section below is kept fully intact; both share one generator instance

highlights.zh: 新增工作台（Studio）操作/交互/UI 与跨模块联动的重构规划文档：以四档视口实测数据为依据（1440×900 工具栏 173px、手机 395px 占视口 47%、常显控件 33 个、首屏只剩 2–5 条轨），给出 5 个冲刺 29 项任务与 v1.17.1–v1.17.13 里程碑，主张推广已有的渐进披露范式而非重写
highlights.en: Added a Studio refactor plan covering operations, interaction, UI and cross-module linkage, grounded in measurements across four viewports (173px toolbar at 1440×900, 395px = 47% of a phone viewport, 33 always-visible controls, only 2–5 of 8 tracks left on the first screen): 5 sprints, 29 tasks, milestones v1.17.1–v1.17.13, extending the existing progressive-disclosure pattern instead of rewriting

title.zh: v1.16.15 修复调音台未播放即满格的假电平，通道控件补到 44px
title.en: v1.16.15 Fixed phantom full-scale console meters and enlarged channel controls to 44px

highlights.zh: 修复真实缺陷：AudioContext 挂起时（首次交互前）WebAudio 返回全 0 帧，而字节时域缓冲以 128 为零线，全 0 被读成 0 dBFS——刚打开页面什么都没播放，所有通道表却顶在红区。现在完全平坦的缓冲一律视为静音（母带表此前也有同样问题）
highlights.en: Fixed a real defect: while the AudioContext is suspended (before the first interaction) WebAudio returns all-zero frames, and since byte time-domain buffers are centred on 128, those read as 0 dBFS — every channel meter sat in the red on load with nothing playing. Flat buffers are now treated as silence (the master meter had the same latent issue)

highlights.zh: 调音台的 M/S/Ø 控件从 28px 提升到 44×44px，通道条相应加宽；目标设备（iPad / 横屏平板）是触摸屏，28px 控件实测难以点中
highlights.en: Console M/S/Ø controls grew from 28px to 44×44px with wider channel strips; the target devices (iPad / landscape tablets) are touch screens where 28px targets are genuinely hard to hit

highlights.zh: 实测：静止 0.0% → 播放 99.9%，电平表由真实信号驱动；触摸目标 26×28px → 44×44px
highlights.en: Measured: meter travel 0.0% idle → 99.9% playing, driven by the real signal; touch targets 26×28px → 44×44px

title.zh: v1.16.14 调音台三处补完：反相可用、主推子真实电平、通道表真实分析器
title.en: v1.16.14 Console completed: working polarity, real master level, real channel meters

highlights.zh: 反相（Ø）真正可用：新增每通道极性级 GainNode（±1），打通数据模型 → 实时引擎 → 离线 WAV 渲染 → 存储（可撤销、随工程持久化）→ 调音台按钮的完整链路；send A/B 也跟随极性
highlights.en: Polarity (Ø) now works end to end: a per-channel ±1 gain stage wired through the data model, realtime engine, offline WAV renderer, store (undoable and persisted) and the console button; the A/B sends follow the polarity too

highlights.zh: 主推子不再猜测：引擎暴露 getMasterVolume() 并把主音量纳入音频设置持久化，调音台挂载时读取真实电平（此前硬编码 0.8）
highlights.en: The master fader no longer guesses: the engine exposes getMasterVolume() and persists the level in audio settings, so the console mounts with the real value instead of a hard-coded 0.8

highlights.zh: 通道电平表改用真实分析器：引擎按需为每通道插入 fftSize=256 的直通分析器（视图卸载即移除），通道表显示真实信号峰值而非音量×声像的估算
highlights.en: Channel meters now read real analysers: the engine inserts a pass-through 256-point analyser per channel on demand (removed when the view unmounts), so the meters show the true signal instead of a volume×pan estimate

highlights.zh: 孤儿审计脚本接入门禁：脚本可查的 159 曲风 + 300 关系 + 11 条时间线故事审计，此前从未被任何流程调用；同时清理 5 个一次性 JS 脚本（scripts/ 由 41 项精简到 17 项）
highlights.en: An orphan audit script is now a real gate: 159 genres + 300 relations + 11 timeline stories, previously never invoked by any pipeline; plus 5 one-off JS scripts removed (scripts/ down from 41 to 17 entries)

title.zh: v1.16.13 依赖收口与仓库清理：Playwright 转正、删除 21 个一次性生成器
title.en: v1.16.13 Dependency tidy-up and repo cleanup: Playwright promoted, 21 one-off generators removed

highlights.zh: Playwright 成为正式 devDependency（lockfile 已同步）：CI 不再需要临时安装步骤，`npm ci && npm run test:e2e` 即可，本地也不需要任何环境变量——已实测 7/7 通过
highlights.en: Playwright is now a proper devDependency with a synced lockfile: CI no longer needs an ad-hoc install and `npm ci && npm run test:e2e` just works locally with no environment variables — verified 7/7

highlights.zh: 删除 21 个一次性 Python 生成器（约 485 KB）。删除前逐一核实无任何引用，删除后 `python3 -m scripts.build_all` 仍校验 159 条曲风、`python3 scripts/package.py` 仍能打出发布包
highlights.en: Removed 21 one-off Python generators (~485 KB) after verifying none is referenced; afterwards `python3 -m scripts.build_all` still validates all 159 genres and `python3 scripts/package.py` still produces the release archive

highlights.zh: 清理本地产物 release/（39 MB）与 scratch/（16 KB），仓库工作区回到干净状态
highlights.en: Removed the local artifacts release/ (39 MB) and scratch/ (16 KB), returning the working tree to a clean state

title.zh: v1.16.12 i18n 债务清理完成：硬编码双语三元降到 100 处以内
title.en: v1.16.12 i18n debt cleared: hardcoded bilingual ternaries down to under 100

highlights.zh: 把 12 个文件中 229 处硬编码的双语文案迁移到词表（AST 口径：259 → 97），全部逐字节校验；新增 229 个中英词条，合并词典达到 1169 项且无重名
highlights.en: Migrated 229 hardcoded bilingual strings across 12 files into the dictionary (AST-measured: 259 → 97), all byte-verified; 229 new en/zh entries bring the merged dictionary to 1169 with no duplicates

highlights.zh: 其余 72 处内联三元是数据字段选择（`isZh ? item.name : item.en`），不属于文案债务，已在文档中明确区分
highlights.en: The remaining 72 inline ternaries select data fields (`isZh ? item.name : item.en`) rather than copy, and the documentation now distinguishes the two

highlights.zh: 修正度量方法：行级 grep 会漏掉跨行三元与一行两处，比 AST 口径少 20–30%——首轮审计的 556/259 都是行级数字，已在规划文档中更正
highlights.en: Corrected the metric: line-based grep misses multi-line ternaries and two-per-line cases, undercounting by 20–30% versus AST. The original 556/259 figures were line-based and the plan document now says so

highlights.zh: 导出/导入失败提示不再可能显示原始的 {error} 占位符（统一经 describeError 生成）
highlights.en: Export/import failure messages can no longer surface a raw {error} placeholder — they now go through a shared describeError helper

title.zh: v1.16.11 曲目外链与来源数量纳入数据门禁
title.en: v1.16.11 Track links and source counts join the data gate

highlights.zh: N-06 验收的"外链可校验"落地为数据门禁：795/795 条代表性曲目链接均为 https 且主机在允许列表内，标题/艺人/年份齐全，每个曲风的来源数量达标，并纳入 lint:data
highlights.en: The 'verifiable links' half of N-06 is now a data gate: all 795 representative-track links are https on an allow-listed host with complete title/artist/year metadata, every genre meets the source minimum, and it runs in lint:data

highlights.zh: 关系覆盖 159/159 由红线 R3c 持续守住；逐曲目的规范链接仍需人工考证，未凭空生成
highlights.en: Relation coverage of all 159 genres stays protected by red line R3c; canonical per-track URLs still need human research and were not invented

title.zh: v1.16.10 同源曲风对比：把关系图谱变成可操作课件
title.en: v1.16.10 Same-origin comparison: the relation graph becomes a usable lesson

highlights.zh: 对比视图新增「同源对比」行：针对当前曲风列出其源自/衍生/相关的曲风，点击即可加入对比，直接 A/B 比较律动源流
highlights.en: The compare view gained a 'same origin' row: for the current genre it lists what it derives from, what it led to and what it is related to — click to add any of them to the comparison and A/B the lineage

highlights.zh: 关系图谱此前只作为装饰性的谱系图存在，现在被解析成结构化的三组同源关系（去重、过滤未知 id 与自环），并新增 9 例完整性测试
highlights.en: The relation graph used to be decorative; it is now resolved into three structured groups (deduped, with unknown ids and self-loops filtered) with 9 integrity tests

highlights.zh: 如实说明：159 条代表性曲目外链需要真实内容创作，未凭空生成；本轮交付的是把现有关系数据变成教学功能
highlights.en: Stated honestly: the 159 representative-track links need real content authoring and were not invented; this release turns the existing relation data into a teaching feature instead

title.zh: v1.16.9 消除移动端 0.19 的布局位移，并补上真实浏览器性能门禁
title.en: v1.16.9 Eliminated the 0.19 mobile layout shift and added a real-browser performance gate

highlights.zh: 定位并修复移动端 CLS 0.191：逐条 layout-shift 记录显示全部来自页脚——懒加载视图挂载前文档刚好一屏高、页脚可见，挂载后被推走 1763px。现在加载占位预留整屏高度，页脚在首屏即位于折叠线以下，位移不再计入
highlights.en: Diagnosed and fixed the 0.19 mobile CLS: every layout-shift record pointed at the footer, which was visible at one-screen height before the lazy view mounted and then pushed down 1763px. Loading placeholders now reserve a full viewport, so the footer starts below the fold and the swap no longer counts

highlights.zh: 星系视图画布高度改用 dvh，移动端浏览器地址栏不再遮挡画布底部
highlights.en: The galaxy canvas now sizes with dvh so mobile browser chrome no longer covers its bottom edge

highlights.zh: CI 与慢轨新增真实浏览器性能门禁（Playwright + 浏览器性能 API），硬性断言首屏不加载多余曲风数据，并打印 FCP/LCP/CLS 供回归对比——替代本机无法安装的 Lighthouse
highlights.en: CI and the slow track gained a real-browser performance gate (Playwright + browser performance APIs) that hard-asserts no unnecessary genre data on first paint and reports FCP/LCP/CLS — replacing the Lighthouse step that cannot be installed here

title.zh: v1.16.8 音序器容器拆分：StudioView 从 2440 行降到 658 行
title.en: v1.16.8 Sequencer container split: StudioView down from 2440 to 658 lines

highlights.zh: StudioView 拆分为 18 个领域 hook 与 5 个子组件/配置模块，容器内 useEffect 从 28 个降到 0；单文件 2440 → 658 行，可读性与可测试性大幅提升
highlights.en: StudioView was split into 18 domain hooks and 5 sub-components/config modules; container useEffect count dropped from 28 to 0 and the file went from 2440 to 658 lines

highlights.zh: 零行为变更，且用三层证据证明：AST 字符串集合对比（0 增 0 失）、jsdom 中拆分前后视图的 innerHTML 逐字节比对（5 个交互状态全部一致）、7 端 e2e 全过
highlights.en: Zero behaviour change, proven three ways: AST string-set diff (0 added, 0 lost), byte-for-byte innerHTML comparison of the pre/post-refactor view across five interaction states in jsdom, and a full 7-target e2e pass

highlights.zh: 跨端测试矩阵新增硬件调音台与空间监听开关检查，新视图不再只靠开发者本机验证
highlights.en: The cross-device matrix now checks the hardware console and the binaural toggle, so the new view is no longer verified only on the developer's machine

highlights.zh: 文档基线自检纳入慢轨，源码规模（文件数/行数）由 version:sync 自动维护，避免文档声称与实现再次漂移
highlights.en: The documentation baseline check joined the slow track, and the stated source size is now maintained automatically by version:sync

title.zh: v1.16.7 硬件调音台视窗、双耳空间监听、工程二维码分享与音频架构收敛
title.en: v1.16.7 Hardware console, binaural monitoring, project QR sharing, and audio architecture convergence

highlights.zh: 新增「硬件调音台」视窗（路线图 P8-02）：8 条通道条含长行程推子与 dB 刻度、声像旋钮、Send A/B、独奏/静音/反相（引擎暂不支持反相，按实情禁用并给出说明）、独立立体声峰值表与红区，主推子与母带表，全部与音序器双向同步
highlights.en: New Hardware Console view (roadmap P8-02): 8 channel strips with long-throw faders and dB scales, pan, Send A/B, solo/mute/phase-invert (honestly disabled — the engine has no polarity control), independent stereo peak meters with a red zone, plus master strip — all bidirectionally synced with the sequencer

highlights.zh: 母带电平表取自真实音频分析器（L/R 时域峰值），通道表由引擎真实的轨道触发回调驱动，均为单条 rAF 直接写 DOM，不产生每帧 React 重渲染
highlights.en: The master meter reads the real stereo analysers (L/R time-domain peak) and channel meters are driven by the engine's real track-trigger callback — one rAF loop writing the DOM directly, with no per-frame React renders

highlights.zh: 新增双耳 HRTF 空间监听（路线图 P8-03）：8 条轨道以 PannerNode 分布在听众前方半圆声场，声像控制映射为方位角；默认关闭，未启用时不消耗 HRTF 卷积开销
highlights.en: Added binaural HRTF monitoring (roadmap P8-03): the 8 tracks are placed on a semicircle via PannerNode with pan mapped to azimuth; off by default, so the HRTF convolution costs nothing until enabled

highlights.zh: 工程中心支持分享链接与二维码：手机扫码即可打开工程；链接过大时明确说明并引导改用 .groove 工程包
highlights.en: The project hub can now share a link and QR code so a project opens by scanning on a phone; oversized patterns explain the limit and point at the .groove package export

highlights.zh: 音频架构收敛：三套引擎共用同一套 VoiceRegistry、主限幅器配置、上下文工厂与总线静音工具，删除重复实现；顺带修复大师课引擎 stop() 之后仍有声音、destroy() 产生未处理 rejection 的问题
highlights.en: Audio architecture convergence: the three engines now share one VoiceRegistry, limiter configuration, context factory and bus-mute helper, removing duplicated implementations — and fixing the masterclass engine leaving sound playing after stop() plus unhandled rejections on destroy()

title.zh: v1.16.6 去掉 92KB 的中文字体 CSS，首屏请求更轻
title.en: v1.16.6 Dropped 92KB of CJK font CSS for a lighter first load

highlights.zh: 实测发现每次访问都会下载约 92KB 的 Google Fonts 样式表（其中包含 Noto Sans SC 的中文 @font-face 声明，解码后 347KB），但实际字体文件一个都没被下载——纯属浪费
highlights.en: Measurement showed ~92KB of Google Fonts CSS on every visit (the Noto Sans SC CJK @font-face block is 347KB decoded) while not a single font file was ever fetched

highlights.zh: 现在只请求两个体积很小的拉丁字体（Space Grotesk / JetBrains Mono），中文改用系统自带的高质量中文字体（PingFang SC / 微软雅黑 / 思源黑体等）
highlights.en: Only the two small Latin families are requested now (Space Grotesk / JetBrains Mono); Chinese text uses the platform's own high-quality CJK fonts

highlights.zh: 首屏传输量因此再降约 92KB（原先 339KB 中约 27% 是这一项）
highlights.en: First-load transfer drops by a further ~92KB (that single request was ~27% of the previous 339KB)

title.zh: v1.16.5 音序器渲染性能、文档防漂移与清理
title.en: v1.16.5 Sequencer render performance, documentation anti-drift, and cleanup

highlights.zh: 音序器渲染：修好被内联 props 击穿的记忆化（TrackRow/StepCell/Ruler/GenreRail/InfoDossier/Toolbar），并把 Toolbar 拆成高频/低频分片；单轨编辑现在只重渲染那一行
highlights.en: Sequencer rendering: fixed memoization that was defeated by inline props across TrackRow/StepCell/Ruler/GenreRail/InfoDossier/Toolbar, and split the Toolbar into high/low-frequency pieces; editing one track now re-renders only that row

highlights.zh: 首屏再减负：对比页的曲风数据不再在任意页面预取，首屏只加载默认曲风本身那一个分包
highlights.en: Lighter first paint: compare-view genre data is no longer prefetched on every page; the first paint now loads only the default genre's own chunk

highlights.zh: 新增真实浏览器性能测量脚本（Playwright），把“首屏不加载多余曲风数据”变成可回归验证的指标，并输出 FCP/LCP/CLS
highlights.en: Added a real-browser performance script (Playwright) that turns 'no unnecessary genre data on first paint' into a regression gate and reports FCP/LCP/CLS

highlights.zh: 文档防漂移：三份规划文档的基线改为自动同步，并新增 docs:check 纳入 CI 与慢轨，杜绝“文档说已交付、实际没做”
highlights.en: Documentation anti-drift: the three planning docs' baselines are now synced automatically, and a new docs:check runs in CI and the slow track

highlights.zh: 数据门禁增强：轻量索引与曲风库的漂移检查、硬编码曲风 id 必须可解析，均已纳入 lint:data
highlights.en: Stronger data gates: index-vs-database drift and hardcoded genre-id resolution are now part of lint:data

highlights.zh: 清理：删除 9 个零引用的设计系统组件、失效的 useGenreGraph hook 及其仅剩的测试
highlights.en: Cleanup: removed 9 unused design-system components and the dead useGenreGraph hook together with its tests

title.zh: v1.16.4 导出结果三格式一致，且不再每次都不一样
title.en: v1.16.4 Exports agree across formats — and no longer change on every render

highlights.zh: 修复导出不一致：MIDI/Ableton 此前忽略概率（30% 的鼓点 100% 被导出），WAV 则每次随机取舍；现在三种格式共用同一套确定性判定，导出的音符集合完全一致
highlights.en: Fixed export divergence: MIDI/Ableton ignored probability (a 30% hit was always exported) while WAV rolled randomly each render; all three now share one deterministic decision, so they export the same notes

highlights.zh: 同一工程重复导出现在完全可复现（不再因随机数产生不同结果）
highlights.en: Re-exporting the same project is now fully reproducible (no more random divergence)

highlights.zh: 新增硬编码曲风 id 守卫测试：任何查表或预设数组引用了不存在的曲风 id 都会立即失败，杜绝“点了没反应”这类静默 bug 再次出现
highlights.en: Added a hardcoded genre-id guard: any lookup or preset list referencing an unknown genre id now fails immediately, so silent dead buttons cannot come back

highlights.zh: 修订审查报告中的一处错误结论：React.memo 并非 0 处，而是 6 处且被内联 props 击穿（结论不变，原因已更正）
highlights.en: Corrected an inaccurate finding in the review document: React.memo is used in 6 components and defeated by inline props (the conclusion stands, the cause is now accurate)

title.zh: v1.16.3 修复「经典预设对比」两个按钮点击无反应
title.en: v1.16.3 Fix: two classic matchup presets did nothing when clicked

highlights.zh: 修复经典预设对比：Synthwave 对决 Cyberpunk 与 Nu-Disco 对决 Funk 引用了不存在的曲风 id，点击后完全无反应；现已修正为 Industrial Techno 与 Nu-Disco House
highlights.en: Fixed the classic matchup presets: 'Synthwave vs Cyberpunk' and 'Nu-Disco vs Funk' pointed at genre ids that do not exist, so clicking them did nothing; they now use Industrial Techno and Nu-Disco House

highlights.zh: 预设解析失败不再静默：缺失的曲风 id 会打印到控制台、播报给读屏并弹出错误提示
highlights.en: Preset resolution no longer fails silently: unknown genre ids are logged, announced to screen readers and surfaced as an error toast

highlights.zh: 新增两层回归测试：预设 id 必须存在于曲风库，且点击预设后对比对象确实发生切换（含反向验证）
highlights.en: Two layers of regression coverage: preset ids must exist in the genre database, and clicking a preset must actually swap the compared pair

highlights.zh: 撤销历史改为按字节预算裁剪（≤4MB），长时间编辑不再常驻数 MB 的深拷贝快照
highlights.en: Undo history is now trimmed by a byte budget (≤4MB) so long sessions no longer retain megabytes of deep-copied snapshots

highlights.zh: 新增真实走带测试：用假 AudioContext 真正调用 play()，覆盖调度、静音、循环区间、停顿恢复与销毁
highlights.en: Added real transport tests: a fake AudioContext now exercises play(), scheduling, mute/solo, loop range, stall recovery and teardown

title.zh: v1.16.2 性能与工程化冲刺：首屏体积减半、状态与导出加固、CI 门禁成型
title.en: v1.16.2 Performance & Tooling Sprint: first paint halved, state/export hardening, CI gates

highlights.zh: 首屏体积：打断曲风数据的静态引用，首屏 JS 从 336KB 降到 164KB gzip（-51%），14 个曲风分包改为点击时按需加载
highlights.en: First paint: broke the static genre-data import — first-paint JS drops from 336KB to 164KB gzip (-51%); the 14 genre chunks now load on demand

highlights.zh: 小节长度修复：恢复拍号分子参与计算（4/4 = 16 步/小节，3/4 = 12，7/8 = 14），标尺分组、小节跳转与复制小节随之正确
highlights.en: Meter fix: bars now count the time-signature numerator (4/4 = 16 steps, 3/4 = 12, 7/8 = 14), correcting the ruler, bar jump and copy-bar

highlights.zh: 工程与分享安全：分享载荷逐字段校验、分享链接不再自不兼容、IndexedDB 失败不再假成功、工程快照按 ID 隔离
highlights.en: Project & share safety: field-level payload validation, self-consistent share links, IndexedDB failures surface, per-project scratch snapshots

highlights.zh: 版本检查载荷从 91KB 降到 3KB，完整变更日志改为打开弹窗时按需加载（并带缓存）
highlights.en: Update check payload drops from 91KB to 3KB; the full changelog archive loads on demand (and is cached)

highlights.zh: 工程化门禁：CI 覆盖 next 分支并补齐 e2e/红线/覆盖率阈值，体积门禁纳入首屏总量，新增 18 条红线兜底
highlights.en: Tooling gates: CI now covers next with e2e, red lines and coverage thresholds; the bundle budget includes total first paint; 18 red lines guard the baseline

highlights.zh: 交互与国际化：Compare 补齐载入/空/错三态与防重入、弹窗打开时全局快捷键失效、原生 window.confirm 换成自研弹窗、4 个文件迁移出内联双语三元
highlights.en: UX & i18n: Compare gained loading/empty/error states and double-click guards, global shortcuts are gated behind dialogs, window.confirm replaced, and four more files moved off inline bilingual ternaries

highlights.zh: SEO 与元数据：补齐描述、Open Graph、Twitter 卡片与运行时 canonical，iOS 图标改用 PNG
highlights.en: SEO: description, Open Graph, Twitter cards and a runtime-derived canonical URL, plus a PNG apple-touch-icon

highlights.zh: 稳定性：消除覆盖率下的大用例超时抖动；实时播放后台队列有界、画布缓冲复用，长时间挂机不再累积
highlights.en: Stability: eliminated the coverage-only timeout flake; bounded the playhead queue and reused the canvas buffer so long sessions stop accumulating

title.zh: v1.16.1 正确性与数据安全冲刺（S0）：音频调度、导出、撤销、工程持久化与分享安全
title.en: v1.16.1 Correctness & Data-Safety Sprint (S0): audio scheduling, export, undo, project persistence, share security

highlights.zh: 音频：消除零音量导致的走带永久卡死（exponentialRamp 非法入参），停顿后按相位跳过积压步进而不是全部齐响
highlights.en: Audio: zero-velocity no longer wedges the transport (illegal exponential ramp targets); stalls now resync in phase instead of firing every missed step at once

highlights.zh: 导出：WAV 母带/分轨现在真正遵循静音/独奏/音量/声像与 probability/swing，与实时听感一致；修复单声道越界与参数越界
highlights.en: Export: WAV master/stems now honour mute/solo/volume/pan plus probability/swing, matching what you hear; fixed mono buffer overflow and out-of-range render params

highlights.zh: 撤销：一个手势只产生一条历史，撤销不再空转；歌曲模式/循环区间/节拍器等设置可被正确还原；重做不再覆盖实时录音
highlights.en: Undo: one gesture records one step and undo no longer no-ops; song mode/loop range/metronome are restored; redo can no longer overwrite a live recording

highlights.zh: 工程：草稿按工程 ID 隔离，切换工程后刷新不会再串档；IndexedDB 写入失败不再假成功，失败原因会明确提示
highlights.en: Projects: scratch snapshots are scoped per project so switching projects no longer cross-contaminates; IndexedDB failures surface instead of pretending to save

highlights.zh: 分享：对 URL 载荷做逐字段校验与白名单重建（防崩溃/防解压炸弹/防原型污染），分享链接不再生成自己打不开的地址，还原时不再丢失门限等细节
highlights.en: Sharing: URL payloads are validated field-by-field and rebuilt from a whitelist (no crashes, no decompression bombs, no prototype pollution); links the app generates are always decodable and no longer drop gate/ratchet detail

highlights.zh: 小节：修复拍号分子被忽略导致的小节长度错误（4/4 每小节恢复为 16 步、3/4 为 12 步、7/8 为 14 步）
highlights.en: Meter: fixed bars ignoring the time-signature numerator (4/4 back to 16 steps per bar, 3/4 to 12, 7/8 to 14)

highlights.zh: 工程化：版本号单一来源、快轨/慢轨门禁、14 条红线兜底、端口可配置、部署凭据注入、测试隔离与 4 个缺失词条补齐
highlights.en: Tooling: single-source version, fast/slow track gates, 14 red lines, configurable ports, deploy credential injection, test isolation, and the 4 missing i18n keys

title.zh: v1.16.0 Web 触觉震颤力反馈引擎（Haptic Engine - P8-01）
title.en: v1.16.0 Web Haptic Engine & Tactile Feedback System (P8-01)

highlights.zh: 全新触觉力反馈引擎：基于 Web Vibration API 的完整打击乐级物理触感系统，支持全局开关与强度调节（10%–100%），设置自动持久化至 localStorage
highlights.en: Full Haptic Engine powered by Web Vibration API: hardware-grade percussion impact system with global toggle and intensity slider (10%–100%), auto-persisted to localStorage

highlights.zh: 播放走带实时触感：每小节下拍（Beat 1）触发沉稳重击（25ms Heavy Thud），小节内各拍触发极微轻点（5ms Metronome Click），打造掌上节拍器物理感
highlights.en: Transport playback haptics: bar downbeats fire heavy thud pulses (25ms), sub-beats trigger ultra-subtle metronome clicks (5ms) for a pocket metronome feel

highlights.zh: 听力挑战触觉反馈：答对时双脉冲庆祝震动（Correct Double Pulse），答错时长震警告（Wrong Answer Buzz），配合 Elo 积分系统增强沉浸感
highlights.en: Challenge mode haptics: correct answers trigger celebratory double-pulse vibration, wrong answers fire warning buzz, enhancing the Elo rating experience

highlights.zh: Toolbar 高级面板一键控制：在 More 设置抽屉新增翡翠绿触感开关与强度滑块，实时调整、即时生效、跨会话记忆
highlights.en: Toolbar advanced controls: emerald-green haptic ON/OFF toggle and intensity slider in the More settings drawer with instant feedback and cross-session persistence

title.zh: v1.15.3 用户自定义曲风与变奏工坊（Custom Genre Maker - P7-03）
title.en: v1.15.3 Custom Genre Maker & Variation Workshop (P7-03)

highlights.zh: 全新「曲风工坊」重磅上线：既可从 159 种内置世界曲风一键分叉变奏（Fork），也可从空白从零定义全新专属曲风与声音美学
highlights.en: All-new Genre Workshop: fork any of the 159 built-in world genres with one click or sculpt entirely new custom genres from scratch

highlights.zh: 6 维声学雷达交互调优：动态调节律动感（Groove）、明亮度（Brightness）、和声复杂度（Harmonic）、节奏密度（Rhythm）、低频能量（Bass）与旋律重心（Melodic），实时 SVG 渲染
highlights.en: Interactive 6-axis acoustic radar: dynamically tune Groove, Brightness, Harmonic Complexity, Rhythm Density, Bass Energy, and Melodic Focus with real-time SVG visualizer

highlights.zh: 8 轨 16 步专属种子 Pattern 步进矩阵：直接绑定 Kick/Snare/Hi-Hat/Perc/Bass/Chords/Lead/FX 核心骨架，支持实时 Web Audio 循环试听与一键导入编曲室
highlights.en: Integrated 8-track 16-step seed pattern matrix: sculpt groove skeletons for all core tracks with live Web Audio auditioning and instant Studio handoff

highlights.zh: Deflate 压缩免服务端 URL 跨端分享与高清海报卡片：纯客户端压缩深链实现离线即时分享，内置 Canvas 2D 离线海报生成器带动态二维码，一键导出 PNG
highlights.en: Zero-backend URL deep sharing & high-res poster cards: deflate-raw compressed URL payloads for offline sharing, paired with Canvas poster generator featuring live dynamic QR code and one-click PNG export

title.zh: v1.15.2 IndexedDB 多工程管理中心与 .groove 离线工程包（P7-02）
title.en: v1.15.2 IndexedDB Multi-Project Hub & .groove Offline Project Packages (P7-02)

highlights.zh: 从单槽本地临时草稿全面升级为企业级 IndexedDB 多工程管理中心，彻底突破 localStorage 5MB 限制，解锁 500MB+ 海量本地持久化容量
highlights.en: Upgraded from single-slot draft to robust IndexedDB Multi-Project Hub: shattered 5MB limit, unlocking 500MB+ offline capacity for >=50 complex projects

highlights.zh: 多工程管理全功能矩阵：支持新建空白工程、从当前工作区另存为、毫秒级一键载入切换（<50ms）、复制分叉、实时重命名、标签系统（#Tags）与标星收藏
highlights.en: Full project lifecycle suite: New project, Save As, sub-50ms instant switching, deep cloning, inline rename, custom tag filtering (#Tags), and star favorites

highlights.zh: 全新 .groove 跨端离线工程包标准：一键导出全工程 JSON 架构（含多 Pattern、DSP 混音、鼓机与步进参数），支持文件选择器与拖拽直接导入
highlights.en: Native .groove offline exchange standard: one-click export/import of complete project state (A/B patterns, master DSP, drum kits, parameters) with drag & drop support

highlights.zh: 智能会话自愈与无缝平滑迁移：自动识别旧版 localStorage 遗留草稿并无损迁移至 IndexedDB，带防抖自保存与崩溃快照保护，刷新与断网绝不丢失编曲灵感
highlights.en: Session resilience & auto-migration: transparently migrates legacy localStorage projects into IndexedDB, coupled with debounced auto-sync and crash recovery

title.zh: v1.15.1 Ableton Live 工程文件（.als）直接导出（P7-01）
title.en: v1.15.1 Ableton Live Set (.als) Direct Project Exporter (P7-01)

highlights.zh: 突破常规 MIDI/WAV 格式边界，利用纯 TypeScript 原生构建 Gzip 压缩的标准 Ableton XML Schema，一键导出完整 .als 工程文件
highlights.en: Direct Ableton Live Set (.als) export: pure TypeScript Gzip XML schema generation for instant DAW project integration

highlights.zh: 预置 8 条专属 MIDI 音轨：完整映射 Kick、Snare、Hi-Hat、Percussion、Bass、Chords、Lead、FX，带轨道命名、Ableton 70 色调色盘、音量电平与立体声像
highlights.en: 8 dedicated MIDI tracks: complete mapping for Kick, Snare, Hi-Hat, Percussion, Bass, Chords, Lead, FX with Ableton 70-color palette, volume, and panning

highlights.zh: 高精度 MIDI Clip 与音符事件映射：完美还原摇摆度（Swing）、多拍子（Polymeter）、步进滚奏（Ratchets）、门限长短与和弦扩展三和弦/七和弦
highlights.en: Precision MIDI clips & KeyTracks: bit-exact preservation of swing offsets, polymeter loop lengths, ratchets, gates, velocities, and chord triad/seventh voicings

highlights.zh: 母带总线与辅助混响延迟总线对齐：预置 A-Reverb 与 B-Delay 辅助返回轨及各轨 Send 发送电平，支持 Ableton Live 10 / 11 / 12 双击直接秒开
highlights.en: Master bus & Return sends: includes Master BPM tempo, time signature, A-Reverb/B-Delay return tracks with double-click support in Ableton Live 10, 11, and 12

title.zh: v1.15.0 全景声谱分析仪与李萨如图示波器（P6-05）、Phase 6 阶段全面达成
title.en: v1.15.0 Panoramic Spectrogram & Lissajous Phase Scope (P6-05) - Phase 6 Complete

highlights.zh: 高精瀑布流全景声谱分析仪 (Waterfall FFT Spectrogram)：60fps 实时对数频率谱图（20Hz - 20,000Hz）+ 连续滚动瀑布历史热力图。提供 4 款声学配色方案（Obsidian Gold、Cyberpunk Neon、Plasma Heat、Phosphor Green CRT），支持瞬态定格分析（Freeze Frame）、峰值驻留监测（Peak Hold）与鼠标悬停精确读数（Hz、音高八度、音分偏差与 dBFS 电平）
highlights.en: Waterfall FFT Spectrogram: 60fps real-time logarithmic frequency spectrum (20Hz - 20kHz) with continuous rolling waterfall heatmap. Features 4 color themes, transient freeze frame, peak hold tracking, and cursor inspection tooltip (Hz, musical note octave, cents deviation, and dBFS)

highlights.zh: 45° 旋转立体声李萨如图示波器 (Lissajous Goniometer)：基于时域 Mid/Side 正交分解的专业级测角仪，模拟 CRT 磷光余辉衰减质感，直观呈现单声道垂直中置脊线与宽广立体声场展开
highlights.en: Lissajous Goniometer & Phase Scope: 45-degree rotated Mid/Side coordinate scope with analog CRT phosphor persistence, visualizing mono center alignment and spatial stereo expansion

highlights.zh: 实时相位相关系数 (r) 与单声道抵消警报：毫秒级计算皮尔逊相关系数 r ∈ [-1.0, +1.0]，配备高精动态电平指示条与红区告警，彻底杜绝在夜店单声道超低音炮与手机扬声器下的声波抵消与梳状滤波
highlights.en: Real-time Phase Correlation (r) & Mono Compatibility Alert: computes Pearson correlation r in [-1.0, +1.0] with dynamic meter bar and anti-phase warnings, preventing destructive comb filtering on mono systems

highlights.zh: 双轨时域波形示波器 (Dual-Trace Oscilloscope)：左/右声道双轨时域电压波形监测，内置过零锁相触发器（Zero-Crossing Sync Trigger），确保波形稳固不漂移，支持 1x/2x/4x 时基缩放
highlights.en: Dual-Trace Waveform Oscilloscope: Left/Right time-domain voltage monitoring with zero-crossing sync trigger for jitter-free waveform stabilization and 1x/2x/4x timebase zoom

highlights.zh: Studio 工作台无缝停靠 (Pro Console Master Dock)：在音序器工具栏一键呼出/折叠（快捷键 O 或 g+z），无缝接驳母带总线 2048 频段高精度分析，零丢帧稳定渲染
highlights.en: Studio Master Dock: toggleable directly from sequencer toolbar or shortcut O / g+z, monitoring master output with zero frame drops

highlights.zh: 独立声学工作台与参考信号发生器 (/analyzer)：全新设立独立工作台与纯 Web Audio 声学信号发生器（20Hz-20kHz 扫频、808 Sub 重低音、Stereo Chorus 垫乐、180° 反相测试音、粉红噪声与白噪声），配套傅里叶变换与 7 大混音黄金频段深度声学档案
highlights.en: Dedicated Workstation & Signal Generator: accessible at /analyzer with pure Web Audio test tones (Sine Sweep, 808 Sub, Stereo Chorus, Anti-Phase, Pink/White Noise) and acoustic physics dossier

highlights.zh: Phase 6 里程碑圆满收官：调式锁定网格（P6-02）、智能琶音器与扫弦（P6-03）、Elo 听力天梯与记忆算法（P6-04）、世界节奏大师课（P6-01）与全景声谱分析仪（P6-05）全部高标准交付，迈向 Phase 7 DAW 生产力闭环！
highlights.en: Phase 6 Milestone Complete: Scale-Locked Matrix, Smart Arpeggiator, Ear Training Elo Ladder, World Rhythm Masterclasses, and Panoramic Analyzer fully delivered!

title.zh: v1.14.8 律动解构：世界节奏沉浸工作坊（P6-01）、毫秒级对拍打卡与一键载入 Studio
title.en: v1.14.8 World Rhythm Masterclasses (P6-01), Live Tap Sync Check & One-Click Studio Baking

highlights.zh: 复节奏声光对撞机（Polyrhythm Collider）：双环多轨同心圆可视化渲染，动态模拟 3:4、4:3、5:4 与 2:3 脉冲交叉干涉与相位碰撞。当双轨光臂在第 1 拍交汇时触发声光核爆与金属对撞音色，直观领悟「Pass the golden butter」声学奇迹
highlights.en: Polyrhythm Collider: dual-ring concentric visualizer simulating 3:4, 4:3, 5:4, and 2:3 phase interference and cycle convergence. Triggers explosive visual and acoustic feedback when pulses collide on beat 1

highlights.zh: Clave 节奏演化树与西非起源（Clave Evolution Tree）：跨越西非 12/8 铁钟神圣母题、古巴 Son Clave 3-2、Rumba Clave 3-2 到巴西 Bossa Nova Clave。高亮呈现 Son 与 Rumba 之间第 3 击半拍微移（Step 6 → Step 7）的声学魔力与 Tresillo/Dos 极性呼应
highlights.en: Clave Evolution Tree & African Roots: explores West African 12/8 bell arch-pattern, Cuban Son Clave 3-2, Rumba Clave 3-2, and Brazilian Bossa Nova Clave, spotlighting the half-beat shift of stroke 3 from step 6 to step 7

highlights.zh: 下拍避让与放克切分动力学（Downbeat Omission Lab）：解构 Fela Kuti 与 Tony Allen 故意空出第一拍（Downbeat Rest）催生的无限推进动力，对照雷鬼 One Drop 在第 3 拍的极重下潜与 James Brown 'The One' 的绝对重力地基
highlights.en: Downbeat Omission Lab: deconstructs Tony Allen and Fela Kuti leaving beat 1 empty for hypnotic forward momentum, compared against Reggae One Drop on beat 3 and James Brown The One ground anchor

highlights.zh: 巴尔干奇数拍与 Aksak 非对称细分（Balkan Odd Meters）：深入解析希腊 7/8 Kalamatianos（2+2+3 短-短-长）、马其顿 7/8 Lesnoto（3+2+2 长-短-短）与土耳其 9/8 Karsilama，基于比例时值方块与 Davul 重低音动态演示民俗步伐舞蹈
highlights.en: Balkan Odd Meters & Aksak Additive Rhythms: breaks down Greek 7/8 Kalamatianos (2+2+3 Short-Short-Long), Macedonian 7/8 Lesnoto (3+2+2 Long-Short-Short), and 9/8 Karsilama with proportional pulse blocks and Davul bass modeling

highlights.zh: J Dilla 微时序与非量化拟人摇摆（Dilla Microtiming）：解构 Akai MPC3000 关闭自动量化后的醉酒微时序步态，配备底鼓前冲（-50ms ~ +50ms）、军鼓迟滞（+35ms Deep Pocket）与 MPC 62% 摇摆滑块，并在物理位移车道上直观展示人脑时间弹性
highlights.en: J Dilla Microtiming & Human Swing: deconstructs unquantized MPC drunk timing with interactive kick push (-50ms to +50ms), laid-back snare drag (+35ms), and MPC 62% swing slider over physical displacement lanes

highlights.zh: 实时对拍打卡与毫秒级时序评测（Live Tap Sync Check）：支持在各课程中敲击 Space 空格键或打击板进行实时对拍打卡，毫秒级计算偏差（Δt ms），提供 PERFECT（≤30ms）、GREAT、GOOD、MISS 判定、连击连胜激励与全课程统计
highlights.en: Live Tap Sync Check: tap Spacebar or the interactive pad on rhythm accents to test millisecond time feel, computing signed delta ms with PERFECT (<=30ms), GREAT, GOOD, and MISS ratings alongside streak counters

highlights.zh: 一键载入 Studio 工作台（Bake into Studio Sequencer）：全套 5 门大师课均支持一键将当前节奏模式与对应预设参数烘焙至 Studio 工作台，自动装载音轨步进、BPM、摇摆与拍号，开启自由混音编曲
highlights.en: One-Click Studio Baking: all 5 masterclasses support one-click baking into Studio Sequencer, automatically transferring multitrack step patterns, tempo, swing, and time signatures for further creation

title.zh: v1.14.7 听力大师 Elo 竞技天梯与艾宾浩斯间隔记忆（P6-04）、混淆矩阵智能复习与全息段位证书
title.en: v1.14.7 Ear Training Elo Competitive Ladder, SuperMemo-2 Spaced Repetition (P6-04) & Holographic Rank Certificate

highlights.zh: Elo Rating 竞技天梯体系（P6-04）：引入国际象棋级 Elo 竞技积分系统，动态匹配题目难度对应分值（1100~1650 Elo 对手强度）与动态 K-Factor 权重（前 10 局定位赛 K=32，高段位 K=16），支持 3 局以上连胜乘数激励与即时浮动分值反馈。划分青铜聆听者（800~1199）、白银鉴赏家（1200~1399）、黄金辨音手（1400~1599）、铂金声学士（1600~1799）、钻石律动宗师（1800~1999）与传奇怪物大师（2000+）六大段位与实时晋级进度条
highlights.en: Elo Rating Competitive Ladder (P6-04): chess-grade Elo competitive rating engine dynamically calibrated against opponent difficulty baselines (1100~1650 Elo) and adaptive K-Factors (K=32 placement, K=16 elite) with streak multipliers and real-time floating delta feedback. Features 6 competitive tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Legendary Master) with live advancement progress bars

highlights.zh: SuperMemo-2 (SM-2) 艾宾浩斯间隔记忆算法：将认知科学与声学听辨深度融合，追踪每位用户的流派记忆间隔（Interval）、轻松度因子（EF）与连续答对次数。根据遗忘曲线自动在最佳认知拐点安排间隔复习（Spaced Review Due），攻克听力盲区
highlights.en: SuperMemo-2 (SM-2) Spaced Repetition Engine: cognitive science meets blind ear training, tracking review intervals, Easiness Factors (EF), and consecutive correct streaks to intelligently schedule review questions right at memory decay thresholds

highlights.zh: 智能亲缘混淆矩阵与自适应干扰项生成：系统自动记录用户历史上容易混淆的近亲流派（如 Liquid DnB 误判为 Neurofunk、Deep House 误判为 Tech House）。在生成题目时，智能从候选池中优先提取历史上多次混淆的干扰项，并在答错时提供专属声学混淆追踪提示
highlights.en: Intelligent Confusion Matrix & Adaptive Distractor Generation: tracks historically confused genre pairs (e.g. Liquid DnB vs Neurofunk) and prioritizes confused siblings when generating multiple-choice options, with real-time feedback detailing spaced repetition scheduling

highlights.zh: 全息高颜值段位证书（Holographic Rank Certificate）：支持一键生成极具仪式感的官方声学段位证书。包含专属段位奖章、当前天梯 Elo 积分、命中率、最佳连胜纪录、攻克流派统计、官方防伪数字指纹哈希（GRV-CERT-*）与评定日期，支持一键复制战报分享
highlights.en: Holographic Ear Training Rank Certificate: one-click generation of official acoustic assessment certificates featuring glowing rank badges, Elo rating, accuracy, best streak, mastered genres, cryptographic verification hash (GRV-CERT-*), and one-click shareable text formatting

title.zh: v1.14.6 智能琶音器与扫弦微动态引擎（P6-03）、一键旋律烘焙与星系星云暖色再平衡
title.en: v1.14.6 Smart Arpeggiator & Strumming Engine (P6-03), One-Click Melody Baking & Galaxy Nebula Warmth Recalibration

highlights.zh: 智能琶音器引擎（P6-03）：和弦工坊全面搭载 5 大经典琶音模式——上行（Up ↗）、下行（Down ↘）、折返（Up-Down ⥱，智能消除顶点与底点停滞）、收敛（Converge ⇥⇤，由外至内八度收敛）与受控随机（Random ⚄），提供流畅奔涌的电子舞曲与合成波琶音脉冲
highlights.en: Smart Arpeggiator Engine (P6-03): Chord Workshop now features 5 classic arpeggiation patterns—Up ↗, Down ↘, Up-Down ⥱ (without peak/valley stutter), Converge ⇥⇤ (outside-in octave convergence), and musical Random ⚄ for flowing dance synth lines

highlights.zh: 扫弦微动态物理模拟与拨片方向：深度仿真原声民谣吉他与电吉他的弹拨微延迟，支持下扫（Downstroke ⬇）、上扫（Upstroke ⬆）与双向交替扫弦（Alternate ⇅），并配备 15ms~75ms 拨片扫弦间隙精细滑条与首弦物理重音衰减
highlights.en: Strumming Micro-Dynamics & Pick Modeling: authentic physical simulation of acoustic and electric guitar pick sweeps, supporting Downstroke ⬇, Upstroke ⬆, and Alternate ⇅ directions with 15ms~75ms customizable pick delay and dynamic string decay

highlights.zh: 一键烘焙至律动工作台（Bake Arpeggio to Studio）：在琶音模式下，点击「一键烘焙至 Lead 轨」或「烘焙至 Chords 轨」，即可将当前和弦走向与所选琶音模式、八度跨度（1-3 Octaves）、门限时值（顿音/自然/连音）瞬间转换为 16 步旋律事件，自动注入律动工作台对应音轨并即时弹奏
highlights.en: One-Click Bake Arpeggio to Studio: with one click, bake the progression with active arpeggio pattern, octaves (1-3), rate (1/8, 1/16, 1/8T, 1/16T), and gate directly into the Studio's Lead or Chords track as a playable 16-step sequence

highlights.zh: 3D 星系星云暖色深度再平衡：彻底修复子曲风星团着色器将环境气体粒子误判为中心星核导致星云变暗的问题。精准限定中心柔化判定（aNode < 14.5 && aStar > 0.5），使各大流派气溶胶与星轨长丝恢复饱和明艳的宇宙星云光晕（House 暖品红、Techno 暖金等），星体璀璨，文字清晰易读，实现无过曝无死暗的黄金视觉观感
highlights.en: 3D Galaxy Nebula Warmth & Radiance Recalibration: resolved shader classification bug where ambient cluster dust was mistakenly crushed. Restored vivid, saturated cosmic halos and radiant filaments (warm magenta for House, gold for Techno) with crisp typography and zero glare blowout

title.zh: v1.14.5 调式锁定音序网格（Scale-Locked Sequencer Matrix）、11大音乐调式引擎与一键全轨对齐
title.en: v1.14.5 Scale-Locked Sequencer Matrix (P6-02), 11-Scale Music Theory Engine & One-Click Track Pitch Quantization

highlights.zh: 调式锁定音序网格（P6-02）：在步进音序器音高编辑（Pitch Picker）与琴键演奏模式中正式引入「调式锁定（Scale Lock）」。内置完整的调式乐理引擎，支持小调五声、自然大调、自然小调、多利亚（Dorian）、弗里吉亚属调式（Phrygian Dominant）、布鲁斯（Blues）、平调子（Hirajoshi）、混合多利亚（Mixolydian）、和声小调等 11 大经典调式
highlights.en: Scale-Locked Sequencer Matrix (P6-02): introduced dynamic Scale Lock in both step pitch editing and musical keyboard play mode. Powered by comprehensive music theory engine supporting 11 classic musical scales (Minor Pentatonic, Natural Major, Natural Minor, Dorian, Phrygian Dominant, Blues, Hirajoshi, Mixolydian, Harmonic Minor, etc.)

highlights.zh: 调内音阶度数标记与防误触锁定：在交互式琴键上清晰标注当前调式音级徽标（★ 根音 R、b3/3 音、5 度音等），一目了然。开启调式锁定时，智能过滤并暗化调外音，彻底消除初学者与即兴编曲误触走音的烦恼；关闭时支持自由 12 半音阶自由创作
highlights.en: In-Scale Degree Badges & Anti-Clash Lock: interactive piano keys display clear harmonic degree badges (★ Root R, 3rd, 5th, 7th). When locked, out-of-scale keys are disabled to eliminate off-key notes during rapid composition, with seamless unlocked chromatic fallback

highlights.zh: 一键对齐全轨调内音（Quantize Track Pitch）：旋律与贝斯音轨支持一键智能量化，将音轨中现存的所有音符根据声学亲和度与最近半音距离，批量自动对齐至当前设定调式，并支持撤销重做与即时听觉反馈
highlights.en: One-Click Track Pitch Quantization: melodic and bass tracks now feature one-click intelligent quantization, snapping existing out-of-scale notes to their nearest in-scale harmonic equivalent with full undo/redo history

highlights.zh: Web MIDI 与电脑键盘实时音阶自适应过滤：在键盘演奏模式下（Z-M 键及外接 MIDI 键盘），实时根据当前曲目调式进行动态音阶过滤与最近音量化，弹奏即和谐
highlights.en: Real-Time Scale-Filtered MIDI & Musical Typing: computer keyboard typing (Z-M row) and external MIDI controllers automatically adapt to the active scale, quantizing incoming notes in real time

highlights.zh: 曲目调式智能识别与跨曲风双向同步：从 159 种曲风自带的 scale 属性中自动解析主音与调式（如 'C minor', 'F# dorian'），调式切换时全局同步至当前工程 pattern.scale
highlights.en: Intelligent Scale Parsing & Cross-Genre Sync: automatically extracts root notes and mode IDs from all 159 genre specifications, keeping pattern.scale synchronized when exploring and modifying tracks

title.zh: v1.14.4 3D 曲风星系星云流光重构、全景星系琥珀微标与空间标签定位校准
title.en: v1.14.4 3D Genre Galaxy Nebular Radiance Overhaul, Cosmic Filter Pill & 3D Spatial Label Calibration

highlights.zh: 3D 银河星系星云与曲风星体全域光辉渲染重构：彻底解决默认视角下星系黑布隆冬看不清的声学天体渲染缺陷。大幅增强着色器内辉光（Inner Glow）与外层星云气溶胶（Smooth Halo）透光度，扩充 14 大流派星云的粒子基底密度、核心辐射光环（Core Radiant Aura）与 159 种曲风星体粒子尺度，呈现宏大深邃、流光溢彩的宇宙声学图谱
highlights.en: 3D Genre Galaxy Nebular Radiance Overhaul: completely resolved the pitch-black visibility issue from the default camera perspective. Re-engineered vertex and fragment shaders with high-luminance halo curves, enhanced nebular aerosol densities across all 14 major genre clusters, and scaled stellar nurseries to create a vivid, glowing celestial atlas of sound

highlights.zh: 子曲风星系聚焦过曝消除与结构文字可视性校准：针对进入具体子曲风分类时因着色器叠加与近景高密粒子造成的白光过曝问题，重构着色器簇内光效。母体星核与环境星尘自动柔化为通透背景，星轨连线与各子曲风星体结构分明、文字清晰易辨；仅在当前 hover 悬停或点击选中特定子曲风时进行克制聚焦高亮，彻底杜绝大片死白
highlights.en: Subgenre Cluster Anti-Glare & Typography Visibility Calibration: eliminated the white wash in close-up cluster view by softening parent core dust into a gentle nebula veil, rendering crisp constellation filaments and legible typography. Selectively highlights only the currently hovered or active subgenre star while maintaining dark cosmic contrast

highlights.zh: 全景星系切换胶囊与多语言国际化修复：移除原先突兀的白色无样式方块（galaxy_filter_all），换装为暗黑星际美学的半透明琥珀辉光胶囊按钮（All Nebulae / 全景星系），并补齐包括拖拽漫游、分支列表与全景返回等缺失的多语言文案
highlights.en: Cosmic All-Nebulae Pill & Localization Completeness: replaced the raw unstyled white strip with a refined cosmic amber glow pill button. Fully localized all missing galaxy labels including 'All Nebulae', navigation hints, branch controls, and overview returns across both English and Chinese

highlights.zh: 3D 投影标签空间定位与初始层叠消除：重构 DOM 标签与 3D 空间坐标变换绑定通道（coreElementsMapRef / subElementsMapRef），彻底修复初始渲染时 14 大核心标签堆叠在左上角遮挡主标题的幽灵层级 BUG，实现标签随 3D 镜头漫游、缩放与聚焦的丝滑贴合
highlights.en: 3D Spatial Label Mapping & Zero-Glitch Initial Projection: wired up reactive element reference maps for core nebulae and subgenres, eliminating the initial frame label accumulation glitch at top-left. Labels now track their exact 3D star clusters in space during camera fly-bys, zooms, and rotations

highlights.zh: 子曲风分支计数插值语法校准：修正子曲风展开栏中「15 {count} 个子曲风分支」的多重插值错误，确保中英双语下数字与分支单位文案准确呈现
highlights.en: Subgenre Counter Localization Fix: resolved redundant count template interpolation in the cluster branch header, ensuring crisp and accurate count formatting across all languages

title.zh: v1.14.3 律动工作台「只听鼓组」快捷切换、跨曲风状态保持与全曲风默认鼓机智能装载
title.en: v1.14.3 Studio Drums-Only Toggle, Cross-Genre State Persistence & Authentic Default Drum Machines

highlights.zh: 律动工作台「只听鼓组」快速切换（快捷键 D）：工具栏新增专属【只听鼓组】（DRUMS）按键与快捷键 D 单键切换。激活时自动平滑静音所有和声与旋律音轨（贝斯、和弦、主音、FX），同时在音序器中聚焦高亮节奏组轨道
highlights.en: Studio Drums-Only Quick Mode (Key: D): added dedicated DRUMS toggle on the toolbar and key 'd' shortcut. Instantly isolates rhythmic drum tracks (kick, snare, hi-hat, percussion) while silencing and dimming harmonic tracks

highlights.zh: 跨曲风切换无缝保持「只听鼓组」状态：在曲风切换过程中，AudioEngine 与工作台状态保持器全程锁定只听鼓组模式，无需用户每次重选，便于在纯节奏声学骨架下横向探索各曲风差异
highlights.en: Cross-Genre Drums-Only Persistence: Drums-Only filter state is seamlessly retained across genre switches, allowing uninterrupted side-by-side rhythmic groove audition

highlights.zh: 159 种曲风默认鼓机智能装载体系：彻底消除所有曲风千篇一律使用 808 的缺陷，根据音乐史实与制作惯例智能映射：Hip-Hop/Trap/Drill 搭载 TR-808，House/Techno/Trance/DnB 搭载 TR-909，Rock/Jazz/Blues/Latin 搭载 Acoustic 真实原声套件，Synthwave/Cyberpunk 搭载 Cyber Wave。切换曲风即刻自动换装对应鼓机
highlights.en: 159 Genre-Specific Authentic Drum Kits: genres now automatically load their historically authentic drum machines—TR-808 for Hip-Hop/Trap, TR-909 for House/Techno/Trance, Vintage Acoustic for Rock/Jazz/Blues, and Cyber Wave for Synthwave

highlights.zh: 快捷键指南（Shortcuts Modal）与焦点穿透优化：在全局快捷键面板中收录 D 键操作，并重构按键监听层，避免按钮聚焦时快捷键被误拦截的问题
highlights.en: Shortcuts Guide & Focus Fallthrough: registered key 'D' in the global shortcuts cheat-sheet and refined event handling to ensure seamless keystroke execution regardless of element focus

title.zh: v1.14.2 律动工作台静音/独奏修复、底鼓设计三层架构与预设系统升级
